title: Technical Animator
description:
Job role:

You're the bridge between our animators and the engine. You'll build the rigs, tools and pipelines that let our animation team bring iconic characters to life in Unreal Engine 5, and make sure what looks great in Maya looks just as great in-game.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves both the art and the problem-solving. You'll work closely with animators, character artists, designers and engineers, and you'll own a real piece of how our games feel to play.



Responsibilities:

Build and maintain production-ready character and creature rigs in Maya, including body, facial and prop rigs

Skin and weight characters for clean deformation across a wide range of motion

Own the Maya-to-Unreal animation export and import pipeline, keeping it reliable and fast

Set up and maintain Animation Blueprints, state machines, blend spaces, montages and retargeting in UE5

Implement and tune runtime systems like IK, Control Rig, physics/cloth and procedural animation

Write Python and MEL tools that speed up animators and kill repetitive work

Profile and optimize animation performance: bone counts, LODs, compression and memory budgets

Troubleshoot animation bugs in-engine and partner with engineering on fixes

Document rigs, tools and pipeline standards so the whole team can move faster



Requirements:

3–5 years as a Technical Animator or Rigger, with at least one shipped game

Strong rigging and skinning skills in Maya, with a portfolio that shows clean deformation

Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine's animation systems: Animation Blueprints, Control Rig, retargeting and Sequencer

Solid Python scripting in Maya; MEL is a plus

A good eye for motion, and you understand what animators need from a rig

Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, with clear written communication

A demo reel or portfolio with a breakdown of your rigging and tools work

title: Direct Response Static Ad Designer for DTC Jewelry Brand (Long-Term)

 & Instagram) and constantly testing new creative angles, concepts, and variations.

title: Remote Bookkeeper / Accountant, Indonesian Tax Compliance
description:
Bali Eco Stay, a hospitality and lifestyle group in Bali | Full-time, Remote (Philippines-based) |



About us

We run a group of hospitality businesses in Bali: an eco-stay with a restaurant, wellness center, stables, and retail brand, plus related ventures. We’re growing, and we need someone to own our numbers so our leadership team can make faster, better decisions.



Who we’re looking for

This isn’t a data-entry role. We want someone who keeps everything compliant and clean and thinks beyond the checklist. You’ll spot where money is leaking, suggest better systems, flag risks before they become problems, and tell us what the numbers actually mean. You follow the rules exactly, and you’re creative about how to do things better within them.



What you’ll do



Own day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple business units (accounts payable and receivable, reconciliations, accruals)

Run the month-end close and deliver a monthly reporting pack by a fixed date: P&L by business unit, balance sheet, cash flow, and key notes

Prepare monthly and annual Indonesian tax obligations: VAT (PPN), withholding taxes (PPh 21, 23, 4(2)), regional hotel/restaurant tax, and annual corporate returns. Coordinate with our local tax consultant as needed

Track filing deadlines and keep a compliance calendar so nothing is ever late

Manage payroll records and staff tax calculations

Build and improve our financial processes: chart of accounts, approval flows, expense controls

Proactively recommend cost savings, pricing insights, and cash-flow improvements



Must-haves



4+ years of bookkeeping/accounting experience, including full month-end close ownership

Hands-on experience with Indonesian taxation (PPN, PPh, Coretax/e-Faktur), or demonstrable ability to learn it quickly with proof of a similar foreign-tax ramp-up

Strong accounting software skills (Xero, QuickBooks, Jurnal, Accurate, or similar) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets

Excellent written and spoken English

Ability to work at least 40 hours a week



Strong pluses



Philippine CPA

Hospitality, F&B, or multi-entity experience

Working knowledge of Bahasa Indonesia, enough to read invoices and tax documents

Experience setting up systems from scratch for a growing business



How to apply

Send your CV, your expected monthly rate, and a short note (max 150 words) describing one time you improved a financial process beyond what was asked. Include the word “Batukaru” in your subject line so we know you read this.

title: Remote Sales & Business Development Representative (Singapore Market)
description:
Company Description



Cleancraft is a Singapore-based cleaning company that provides professional, tailored cleaning solutions for homes, offices and retail spaces across the island. The company offers a full suite of commercial services, including daily office and retail cleaning, as well as post-renovation cleaning for workplace environments. For residential clients, Cleancraft delivers general home cleaning, packing and unpacking support, post-tenancy and post-renovation cleaning, and specialised mattress and upholstery cleaning. Cleancraft’s mission is to help clients reset their spaces and build healthy environments they can be proud of.



We’re growing both our residential and commercial business. We want someone who can turn enquiries into bookings and start new conversations with homeowners, businesses and property partners across Singapore.



The role



This is a fully remote role based in the Philippines. We share the same time zone (GMT+8), so you’ll work closely with our Singapore sales and operations team every day.



This is a target-driven role covering two areas:



Residential: turning enquiries from homeowners into confirmed bookings

Commercial: finding and booking meetings with businesses and property managers



What you’ll do



Residential



- Respond quickly to enquiries from our website, WhatsApp, Instagram and

- Recommend the right service (weekly regular home cleaning, post-renovation, move-in or move-out, deep cleaning) and send quotations

- Follow up on quotes and turn enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Build referral partnerships with interior designers, renovation contractors and property agents



Commercial



- Research and build lists of B2B prospects: offices, retail, condos (MCSTs) and property managers

- Run outreach on LinkedIn,
 and phone to generate interest

- Qualify leads and arrange site visits and meetings, coordinating with our Singapore sales and operations teams, who handle all on-site visits



Both



- Keep the lead tracker accurate and up to date

- Report weekly on enquiries, conversions, appointments booked and pipeline



What we’re looking for



- 1–3 years’ experience in sales, lead generation or appointment setting, ideally including prospecting and qualifying leads. Experience with Singapore, Australian or other overseas clients is a plus.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to present solutions clearly, handle objections and build long-term client relationships

- Quick, friendly and professional on WhatsApp and chat

- Self-motivated and organised, comfortable working to targets with little supervision

- Comfortable using CRM tools, Google Sheets and online communication platforms

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet place to work from home

- Experience in services, cleaning, facilities management or related industries is an advantage

- A diploma or degree in Business, Marketing or a related field is preferred but not required



What we offer



- Full-time, permanent remote role. Work from home in the Philippines.

- Working days: Wednesday to Sunday (Monday and Tuesday off), [9am–6pm] GMT+8

- Monthly salary of PHP 35,000, plus performance incentives for confirmed bookings and qualified appointments

- 13th-month pay and statutory benefits (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG)

- Paid leave and public holidays

- A small, supportive team where your results are clearly visible, and room to grow as we expand!

title: Part-Time UAE Accountant / Bookkeeper (Remote)
description:
Part-Time Accountant / Bookkeeper | UAE Accounting Practice | Remote



Company: Quill Accounting Services, Dubai, UAE

Location: Remote, Philippines

Position: Part-Time Independent Consultant

Hours: Flexible, with availability during UAE business hours

Rate: Competitive hourly rate, dependent on experience



About Us



Quill Accounting Services is a growing Dubai-based accounting practice supporting a varied portfolio of UAE businesses with bookkeeping, management accounts, VAT and Corporate Tax compliance.



We are looking for an experienced, hardworking and reliable accountant to support our Finance Manager with day-to-day accounting and tax compliance.



This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can work independently, take ownership of tasks and consistently meet deadlines.



Key Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Financial Reporting



Maintain accurate bookkeeping records across multiple UAE clients.

Process sales invoices, purchase invoices, bank transactions and journals.

Prepare month-end adjustments, including accruals, prepayments, depreciation and payroll.

Complete bank and balance sheet reconciliations.

Review trial balances, investigate discrepancies and prepare monthly management accounts.

Maintain clear working papers and supporting documentation.



UAE VAT & Corporate Tax



Prepare and submit UAE VAT returns through the FTA EmaraTax portal.

Understand UAE VAT treatments, including standard-rated, zero-rated, exempt and out-of-scope transactions.

Apply correct VAT treatment to overseas transactions, imported services, reverse charge and recoverable/non-recoverable input VAT.

Prepare VAT reconciliations and supporting schedules.

Assist with Corporate Tax computations and annual CT return filings.

Complete VAT and Corporate Tax registrations, amendments and related FTA submissions.

Monitor client FTA portals, registration requirements, filing deadlines and outstanding compliance actions daily.



Requirements



Strong practical bookkeeping and accounting experience, ideally within an accounting practice.

Experience using Xero, including journals, reconciliations and financial reporting.

Previous hands-on experience preparing and submitting UAE VAT returns is essential.

Good understanding of UAE Corporate Tax and FTA compliance.

Strong Excel skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines independently.

Reliable, proactive and responsive, with good English communication skills.



Working Arrangement



This is a part-time independent consultancy position, not a full-time salaried role.

Work will be allocated based on client requirements and the receipt of monthly accounting records. Workloads may vary from week to week, particularly around VAT and Corporate Tax deadlines.

We are looking to establish a long-term relationship with a consultant who can provide regular availability during agreed UAE working hours.

There are no guaranteed monthly hours initially. Additional work may become available as our client portfolio continues to grow.



How to Apply



Please send your CV to 
 with the subject Part-Time Accountant Application.



In your
, please confirm:



Your experience with UAE bookkeeping, VAT and Corporate Tax.

Whether you have personally submitted VAT returns and registrations through EmaraTax.

Your experience using Xero and managing multiple clients.

Your expected hourly rate in AED or USD.

Your weekly availability and earliest possible start date.

title: Full-Time Real Estate Virtual Assistant (FUB Expert & Operations)
description:
Role: Full-Time Real Estate Virtual Assistant (FUB Expert & Operations)

We are a rapidly growing real estate group expanding a high-performing Zillow preferred team, and we are looking for an experienced, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to run our day-to-day CRM operations, handle client communications, and assist in scaling our systems.

This is a dedicated, full-time position for a committed professional—strictly single-job only. Please do NOT apply if you have other clients, moonlight, or hold multiple jobs. We need someone who is 100% focused, responsive, and present during our operating hours.

Schedule & Commitment

 • Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Pacific Time (PT)

 • Work Days: Friday through Tuesday (Off days: Wednesday & Thursday)

 • Type: Full-time (40 hours/week, 100% remote)

Key Responsibilities

 • CRM Management & Lead Flow: Act as our primary Follow Up Boss (FUB) administrator—organizing databases, tracking lead stages, ensuring pipeline hygiene, and running smart lists and action plans.

 • Communications & Lead Response: Promptly answer incoming calls, conduct client follow-ups, and manage SMS/text messaging with exceptional professionalism and warmth.

 • AI Agent Implementation: Assist in setting up, testing, and fine-tuning an AI voice/chat agent to automate speed-to-lead, initial inquiries, and basic triage for our inbound pipeline.

 • Agent Onboarding & Training Support: Help train and onboard incoming agents onto our tech stack (Follow Up Boss, communication protocols, lead handling best practices).

 • Social Media & Marketing: Create, schedule, and curate creative, engaging real estate content across social media channels to boost brand presence.

 • Administrative & Transaction Support: Handle data entry, prepare documents, track key dates/deadlines, and keep daily administrative workflows running seamlessly.

Qualifications & Requirements

 • Direct experience with Follow Up Boss (FUB) is required. Deep familiarity with smart lists, automations, action plans, and tagging.

 • Real estate background: Proven track record supporting a busy real estate team or high-volume sales environment (experience supporting Zillow lead pipelines is a huge plus).

 • Tech-forward mindset: Familiarity with AI tools, AI communication agents, and modern productivity software.

 • Flawless English proficiency: Exceptional verbal communication (clear phone presence) and polished written skills.

 • Strong organizational skills: High attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and the ability to multitask without dropping the ball.

 • Home Office Standards: High-speed, stable internet connection with backup power/connectivity, a quiet work environment, and a reliable, modern computer setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter addressing:

 1 Your hands-on experience with Follow Up Boss and real estate lead pipelines.

 2 Any experience you have with AI tools, chatbots, or automations.

 3 A brief example of how you have trained or onboarded others on software/tools in the past.

 4 Explicit confirmation that you are available for Friday–Tuesday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PT, and that you do not hold any other full-time or part-time roles/clients.

General Operations Analyst / Assistant Coach



Location: Remote (Philippines preferred)

Schedule: Full-Time (40 hours/week), fixed shift

Timezone: Pacific Time (PT)

Type: Long-term, stable role



About the Role



We are hiring a Full-Time General Operations Analyst / Assistant Coach to support a fast-growing online fitness coaching business.



This is a broad, execution-focused role at the center of the business. You will support clients, keep our content pipeline on schedule, handle Instagram DM operations, and keep our data and systems accurate. The role combines:

-Client coaching support and client messaging

-Content operations, including our trial reel initiative

-Instagram DM operations and lead qualification

-Reporting, analytics, and systems

-Using AI tools to create and speed up work



The day will shift between priorities. Some parts of the shift are real-time (client messages, Instagram DMs, team requests on Slack), and the rest goes to coaching, content, and operations tasks.



This position is best suited for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, strong with numbers, reliable with deadlines, and comfortable switching between tasks while following SOPs.



Key Responsibilities



Client Coaching Support & Messaging

-Respond to client messages and check-ins in a timely, professional way

-Update and manage client training programs and meal plans

-Calibrate clients' completed workouts and adjust weights and progressions based on our SOP

-Create weekly meal plans using templates, customized to each client's preferences

-Monitor client adherence, feedback, and progress, and flag issues early

-Keep all client data accurate in our coaching platform and internal trackers



Content Operations & Trial Reels

-Own our trial reel initiative from planning to delivery

-Manage the video editor so trial reels are delivered on time and to standard

-Track deadlines, follow up on anything late, and keep the content pipeline moving

-Schedule and post trial reels, and log what went live

-Track content performance and report what's working and what isn't



Instagram DM Operations & Lead Qualification

-Monitor and respond to inbound Instagram DMs during assigned hours

-Follow scripts and SOPs to nurture leads and manage follow-ups

-Qualify leads based on set criteria (goals, readiness, budget, etc.)

-Route qualified leads to the booking link / sales call

-Track DM metrics (response rate, qualified rate, booked calls)



Reporting, Analytics & Systems

-Maintain dashboards and reports in Google Sheets and Airtable

-Track and validate Meta ads data and funnel performance

-Run data QA so our numbers are accurate

-Support automations (Zapier, Make, CRM) and report anything broken

-Follow, update, and help write SOPs



AI-Assisted Work

title: Career, Outreach & Business Operations Assistant
description:
# Virtual Executive Assistant — Career, Outreach & Business Operations



## Position Overview



I am looking for a highly organized, resourceful, AI-savvy Virtual Executive Assistant to help manage my job search, professional networking, follow-ups, calendar, personal priorities, and business-related scheduling.



This is not a basic administrative VA position.



I need someone who can take ownership of ongoing tasks, conduct independent research, use AI effectively, pay close attention to details, identify problems before I notice them, and help make sure my professional and personal commitments stay organized.



A major part of this position will involve managing my job-search process from beginning to end.



## Primary Responsibilities



### 1. Job Research



Find relevant employment opportunities for me every business day using:



- My resume and professional background

- ChatGPT/AI

- JobHacki.com

- LinkedIn

- Indeed

- Company career pages

- Other reputable job platforms



Primary target roles include:



- Sales Development Representative — SDR

- Business Development Representative — BDR

- Account Executive — AE

- Sales Representative

- Business Development

- Partnerships

- Creator/Influencer Partnerships

- E-commerce sales

- Social commerce/TikTok Shop-related sales



Priority industries include:



- Music

- Music technology

- Influencer marketing

- Creator economy

- TikTok/social commerce

- E-commerce

- Artificial intelligence

- SaaS

- Healthcare

- Medical technology

- Food delivery

- Logistics/delivery technology

- B2B services

- B2C services



### Job Qualification Criteria



Prioritize positions that are:



- Entry-level

- No experience required

- Training provided

- Sales trainee programs

- New graduate/early career friendly

- 0–2 years of required sales experience

- Open to transferable experience

- Remote, hybrid, or geographically relevant to me



Do NOT blindly apply to jobs simply to meet an application quota.



Every opportunity should first be checked against my qualifications and career goals.



Target: approximately **10 qualified applications per business day / 50 per week** when enough suitable opportunities are available.



---



## 2. Resume Tailoring



Before submitting applications:



1. Read the complete job description.

2. Compare the position against my master resume.

3. Identify discrepancies, missing information, weak wording, or potential conflicts.

4. Identify the most important skills, responsibilities, keywords, and qualifications from the job posting.

5. Use my established AI resume formula/process to determine appropriate changes.

6. Manually edit the resume using my existing Google Docs resume template.

7. Preserve the formatting and structure of the template.

8. Verify every statement for accuracy.

9. Never invent experience, accomplishments, companies, credentials, dates, or skills.

10. Proofread the finished resume before submitting it.



Each significant opportunity should receive an appropriately tailored resume rather than sending the exact same generic resume everywhere.



---



## 3. Job Applications



Manage the application process from beginning to end.



Responsibilities include:



- Completing applications

- Uploading the correct tailored resume

- Completing standard screening questions

- Maintaining accurate applicant information

- Saving job descriptions when necessary

- Recording application confirmation

- Tracking next steps

- Monitoring deadlines

- Preventing duplicate applications



Approximately 10 qualified applications should be completed per business day.



Applications requiring unusual legal declarations, salary commitments, assessments, recorded video responses, lengthy personality tests, contracts, or information that has not already been authorized should be flagged for me rather than guessed.



---



## 4. Application Tracking



Maintain a master Job Search Tracker.



Each application should include:



- Company

- Position

- Industry

- Location

- Remote/hybrid/on-site

- Salary or compensation range

- Job URL

- Source

- Date discovered

- Date applied

- Resume version used

- Application status

- Recruiter/hiring manager

- Contact information

- Follow-up date

- Interview date

- Interview stage

- Next action

- Notes

- Rejection/offer status



Application stages should be standardized, such as:



**Found → Reviewed → Approved → Resume Tailored → Applied → Follow-Up Due → Recruiter Contact → Interview → Final Interview → Offer / Rejected / Closed**



---



## 5. Follow-Ups



Do not allow submitted applications to simply disappear after submission.



Create and maintain a follow-up system.



Examples:



- Initial recruiter/hiring manager outreach

- Application follow-up

- Interview thank-you

- Interview follow-up

- Networking follow-up

- Mentorship follow-up

- Meeting follow-up



Track when each follow-up should happen and alert me when my involvement is required.



---



## 6. Professional Networking & Mentorship



Regularly research professionals I could learn from or build relationships with.



Priority industries include:



- E-commerce

- TikTok Shop/social commerce

- Influencer marketing

- Creator management

- Music business

- Artist management

- Music marketing

- Sales

- Business development

- AI

- Entrepreneurship

- Partnerships



Potential contacts may include:



- Executives

- Founders

- Directors

- Managers

- Experienced operators

- Sales leaders

- E-commerce professionals

- Creator managers

- Music executives

- Industry consultants



The objective is relationship building and mentorship—not mass spam.



For each strong contact:



1. Research their background.

2. Determine why the person is relevant to my goals.

3. Identify a legitimate point of connection.

4. Draft a personalized outreach message.

5. Track the outreach.

6. Schedule an appropriate follow-up.

7. Record responses and meetings.



Quality is more important than sending hundreds of generic messages.



---



## 7. Calendar & Schedule Management



Help manage my:



- Interviews

- Professional meetings

- Mentorship calls

- Business meetings

- Appointments

- Personal commitments

- Work obligations

- Deadlines

- Follow-ups

- Projects



Before adding or recommending a commitment, check my existing schedule.



The goal is not to fill every available hour.



My schedule should remain realistic and sustainable.



Consider:



- Travel time

- Preparation time

- Work commitments

- Business responsibilities

- Personal obligations

- Meals

- Sleep

- Recovery time

- Transition time between meetings

- Existing priorities



Flag scheduling conflicts before they become a problem.



---



## 8. Daily Executive Summary



At the end of each workday, send me a concise executive summary containing:



### Applications

- Jobs found

- Jobs applied to

- Companies

- Positions

- Important opportunities requiring my attention



### Follow-Ups

- Follow-ups completed

- Follow-ups due tomorrow

- Responses received



### Networking

- Professionals researched

- Outreach sent

- Responses

- Meetings scheduled



### Calendar

- Tomorrow's appointments

- Interviews

- Meetings

- Deadlines



### Action Required From Me

Clearly identify anything that requires my personal involvement.



Example:



**ACTION REQUIRED**

1. Complete assessment for Company A.

2. Review interview invitation from Company B.

3. Approve outreach message to executive at Company C.



---



## 9. Weekly Executive Check-In



At the beginning of each week, ask:



**"What are your goals and plans for this week?"**



Then help translate those goals into an achievable weekly schedule.



Review:



- Career priorities

- Job-search targets

- Interviews

- Networking goals

- Business priorities

- Personal obligations

- Appointments

- Deadlines

- Unfinished tasks from the previous week



The weekly plan should be realistic rather than overloaded.



---



# Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by organization and quality—not simply hours worked.



Key expectations include:



- Approximately 10 qualified job applications per business day

- Approximately 50 qualified applications per week when sufficient opportunities exist

- Applications accurately tracked

- No duplicate applications

- Resume customized when appropriate

- No fabricated resume information

- Important follow-ups completed on time

- Interviews and appointments properly tracked

- Schedule conflicts identified in advance

- Professional networking conducted consistently

- Daily summaries delivered consistently

- Weekly planning completed consistently



---



# Required Skills



The ideal candidate should be strong in:



- Online research

- Google Docs

- Google Sheets

- Google Calendar

- Gmail/email management

- LinkedIn

- Job boards

- ChatGPT/AI tools

- Resume editing

- Written English

- Professional communication

- Scheduling

- Organization

- Attention to detail

- Independent problem solving



You should be comfortable learning new AI tools and workflows.



Experience with recruiting, job-search assistance, executive assistance, sales recruiting, sourcing, LinkedIn outreach, career services, or business development is highly valuable.



---



# What I Do NOT Want



I am not looking for someone who:



- Blindly submits Easy Apply applications

- Uses the same resume for everything

- Mass-spams professionals

- Fabricates information with AI

- Applies to clearly unqualified jobs just to hit a quota

- Requires instructions for every small decision

- Loses track of follow-ups

- Overbooks my calendar

- Says a task is complete without verifying it

- Uses AI output without reviewing it



I want someone who can operate like an executive assistant and project manager.



---



# Ideal Personality



You are:



- Extremely organized

- Proactive

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable

- Curious

- Resourceful

- Comfortable with technology

- Comfortable asking questions when information truly cannot be determined

- Capable of following detailed systems

- Able to notice inconsistencies

- Able to prioritize independently



Most importantly, you should be capable of thinking:



**"What needs to happen next?"**



instead of waiting for me to assign every next step.



---



# Application Instructions



When applying, please include:



1. Your executive/virtual assistant experience.

2. Your experience applying to jobs for clients.

3. Your experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT.

4. Your experience with Google Docs and Sheets.

5. Your experience with LinkedIn research/outreach.

6. An example of a system you have used to manage recurring tasks or follow-ups.

7. Your weekly availability.

8. Your time zone.

9. Your desired hourly or monthly rate.



Please begin your application with the phrase:



**"Career Operations"**



so I know you carefully read the description.

title: Video Editing_Cut 200 exercise loops from raw 4K gym footage (vertical, Photoshop set extension)
description:
Description

I run a fitness app and need short exercise demo loops cut from raw gym footage. This is repetitive production work, not creative editing. Everything is spelled out in a one-page guide with an overlay template, before/after examples and finished samples.

Everything you need is here: 

Open "DadUnit Editor Kit" and read "1 START HERE" first. The three finished MP4s in "5 FINISHED SAMPLES" are what a delivered loop looks like. "Sample of what the raw footage looks like" is a raw take.

The footage: long 4K vertical takes on a tripod, one person doing many exercises back to back. Before most sets I say the exercise name out loud.

For each set (about 200 in the first batch, up to 400 total):

• Find where the movement begins and get the exercise name from the audio. No name, flag it.

• Cut 3 clean reps in a row into a seamless loop (usually 8-15 seconds)

• Reframe it on the provided guide overlay so the athlete sits in the right spot

• Build a set extension where needed. Some camera setups were filmed too tight, so you'll extend the background in Photoshop (Generative Expand) and composite the clip over it. One extended background per camera position, reused across every clip from that position.

• Color grade to match the provided reference stills (dark gym, warm skin, high contrast). One preset per camera position.

• Export 1080x1920 MP4, no audio

You need:

• Set extension skills: Photoshop Generative Fill / Generative Expand, plus compositing a video clip over a still background with a feathered mask so no seam shows

• An editor with masking and color tools (Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut or CapCut Pro are all fine)

• Enough disk space and download speed for large 4K files

• To follow a written spec exactly and flag anything you're unsure about instead of guessing

How it works: the first batch of about 200 loops is the test. The budget for it is $400 total, paid as loops are delivered and approved. If the result is good, a second batch of about 200 follows at the same rate.

To bid, send:

1. Confirm you can do the first batch of about 200 loops for $400, and how you want that split into milestones

2. How many loops you can deliver per week

3. Which editing software you use

4. One example of a set extension you've done (a before and after is perfect)

Budget

$400 for the first batch of 200 loops ($2 per loop). This is fixed, not a starting point.

Delivery

30 days.

Attachments (each under Fiverr's 25 MB cap, all in the kit folder on the content drive and in Drive)

• 2 OVERLAY / OVERLAY 1080x1920.png

• 3 EXAMPLES / Curl - BEFORE (as shot).jpg

• 3 EXAMPLES / Curl - AFTER (placed on plate).jpg

title: AWS MediaLive Engineer Needed for Simple One Laptop Test
description:
The simplest way to prove the remaining limitation is to run a controlled test using one camera-connected laptop for all three source-side functions.



Simplest test



On one laptop:



1. Connect or activate the laptop’s camera.

2. Run OBS and push the captured stream to an AWS MediaLive RTMP input.

3. From that same laptop, use the AWS CLI to submit:

   - Three MediaLive destinations for YouTube,
, and Twitch.

   - One BatchUpdateSchedule request containing an image URI or motion-graphics URL.

4. Start the MediaLive channel.

5. Confirm that:

   - MediaLive receives the camera stream.

   - The overlay appears.

   - MediaLive sends outputs to the three destinations.



The key is using the AWS CLI on the same laptop because the commands, request files, timestamps, and CloudTrail events are easier to preserve than browser activity.



Minimum evidence needed



You need only four coordinated evidence categories:



1. Continuous screen recording



Record the entire operation showing:



- The laptop’s identity and clock.

- The connected camera.

- OBS sending the stream.

- The AWS CLI submitting the destination configuration.

- The AWS CLI submitting the overlay schedule action.

- The resulting overlay and social-platform outputs.



2. OBS log



The OBS log should establish:



- The camera source.

- The MediaLive RTMP endpoint.

- The stream start time.

- The originating computer.



3. CloudTrail records



Preserve the events showing:



- The destination configuration.

- The BatchUpdateSchedule request.

- The overlay URI or URL.

- The IAM principal.

- The source IP address.

- The user agent.

- The channel ID.

- The event timestamps.



4. MediaLive configuration and logs



Export:



- describe-input

- describe-channel

- the channel schedule

- MediaLive encoder logs

- MediaLive as-run logs



These records connect the stream, destinations, and overlay action to the same MediaLive channel.



Strongest simple correlation



The proof chain would be:



1) One identified laptop



2) OBS sends captured content

+ AWS CLI submits three destinations

+ AWS CLI submits overlay URL

3) Same MediaLive channel processes all three inputs



Use the same:



- laptop;

- IAM identity;

- public IP address;

- MediaLive channel ID;

- test name; and

- narrow timestamp window.



A dedicated /32 input-security rule for the laptop’s public IP adds corroboration, although it should not be the only proof.



What this proves



This controlled test would prove that:



> One qualifying source user device can supply the captured digital content, supplemental-content identifier, and plural target identifiers to one MediaLive configuration.







That closes the missing technical limitation for the tested configuration.



Important limitation



The test proves technical operation and capability in the tested configuration. It does not, by itself, prove that Amazon or a particular AWS customer historically operated that configuration. Historical use would require customer logs, AWS records, testimony, source code, or discovery.



Confidence: High that this is the simplest technically reliable method. The best minimal package is a continuous screen recording, OBS log, CloudTrail events, and MediaLive configuration and logs.

You'll own Meta campaigns for our kitchen, bath, and room addition clients from start to finish: strategy, creative, launch, and optimizing. Your ads are the first thing every homeowner touches.

This role is paid per client, per month. You start with one client account. Do great work and you get more.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Clear written English

BONUS POINTS

GoHighLevel and funnel experience

WHY AGEN GROWTH

title: Head of Finance
description:
Reports to: Managing Director. Dotted line to the Chief Executive of the membership business for its priorities

Works with: Finance Lead, Operations. Finance Assistant via the Finance Lead. Operations leads on budgets

Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week

Engagement Independent contractor, Philippines based, remote, Australian business hours overlap



About the group

A privately owned Australian group of four operating businesses, with a finance team based in the Philippines working to Australian business hours. One of the businesses is a membership organisation funded by supplier rebate income, which is about to take on two new activities: holding and paying supplier accounts on behalf of its members, and offering a paid service tier on top of free membership. The finance function is being strengthened to support that growth.



Purpose

Lead the finance function across the group. Bring the four entities into one clean financial picture with each standing on its own numbers, own budgets and forecasts for all of them, set credit control policy, and be the finance owner of the membership business’s new commercial programs: consolidated supplier accounts, the paid service tier and the rebate P&L. Build the models that say whether things work, the operations that make them run and the controls that stop them going wrong, then hand the running to operations with a documented process while staying accountable for the numbers.



Responsibilities (accountable)

Group consolidation and reporting standards

•Monthly consolidated reporting across the four entities, each on its own numbers; intercompany reconciled, no unexplained balances.

•One set of reporting standards, controls and a month-end calendar for all entities.

•Audit, tax and statutory compliance across entities, including ATO obligations (BAS, IAS, STP, payroll finalisation). Accountant, auditor and bank relationships.

Budgets and forecasting, all entities

•Annual budget and quarterly reforecast for every entity and the group view, built from definitions not rolled forward, including capital equipment replacement allowances.

•The Finance Lead builds the entity detail with operations; this role is accountable for the output.

Australian payroll compliance and Philippines contractor payments

•Accountable for Australian payroll compliance (ATO, STP, superannuation, payroll tax where applicable) and for the Philippines contractor payment framework: agreements on file, agreed hours and rates, any withholding or documentation the contracts require. Approves each payroll run and contractor payment run before it is paid.



Credit control policy

•Credit terms by customer type, credit limits, stop-supply rules, the point at which an account goes to formal recovery.

•One aged debtors report for all entities to the Managing Director every month.

Membership business finance

•Monthly P&L, cash and variance, presented to the Managing Director and Chief Executive and explained.

•Rebate income by supplier, reconciled to supplier statements and member purchasing data. Breakeven and the membership growth needed to reach it.

•Cost and return on member programs so the Chief Executive can see what each costs per member and what it brings in.

Consolidated supplier accounts (design and pilot)

•Design the finance operations before anything is built: invoice intake and matching, member statement cycle, collections and direct debit mandates, supplier payment runs, rebate netting, reconciliations, month-end close.

•Credit limits per member, exposure model (average monthly supplier spend times members on the platform), bad debt watch, suspension path.

•Specify what the platform must produce for finance and test it before go-live. Run the pilot, document, hand to the Finance Lead.

Paid service tier and supplier economics

•Business case and pricing model: fee on managed spend not revenue, a net-ahead test for every member, cash flow timing so the business never funds the gap between collecting and paying. Say plainly if the fee exceeds the benefit for a member type.

•What consolidated prompt payment is worth to a supplier and what additional discount it should buy, additive to the existing rebate.

•The numbers behind every supplier negotiation and renewal; financial pages for the board and partners.

Backup responsibilities (Finance Lead’s areas)

•Able to run month-end close for every entity, collections operations, transaction processing and the live consolidated accounts function. Covers in full during the Finance Lead’s leave.



What this role is not

•Not the commercial designer of the new programs; those decisions sit with the Managing Director and Chief Executive. This role builds and stress tests the numbers and the operations underneath them.

•Not a technology role. It specifies what finance needs from the platform and tests what is delivered.

•Not an advocate for any one entity inside another. Where one group business supplies another, it is treated as any other supplier in every model.



Measures

•Group consolidation delivered monthly; no unexplained intercompany balances within three quarters.

•Membership business reported on its own numbers by the agreed day; rebate P&L closed and maintained.

•Budgets and reforecasts delivered to the calendar for every entity.

•Consolidated accounts process documented, tested and running through pilot, reconciled monthly.

•Paid tier business case and pricing model delivered on real inputs and defensible with the board.

•Debtor days and overdue balances (60 and 90 days) by entity against targets; bad debt written off.

•Owner and backup list in place; leave covered without a gap.



Experience

•Multi-entity finance management, consolidation and intercompany reconciliation. Full set of accounts through to audit, with Australian compliance (ATO, BAS, STP).

•Credit control and collections at scale. Xero essential; NetSuite and MYOB useful. Advanced Excel modelling.

•Leading a finance team across locations; presenting to directors and boards. Membership, rebate or multi-site retail experience useful, not required.

title: EXPERIENCED EDITOR — LONG-TERM FREELANCE  (SHORT TERM budget is $1,000+ USD/// LONG TERM CAN BE MUCH MORE)
description:
PLEASE READ ALL REQUIREMENTS BEFORE APPLYING



We're looking for one experienced, dependable editor who wants to grow into a larger creative production role over the next 1–2 years, ideally much longer.



This position starts with straightforward audio editing, but that's only the first stage. Our goal is to gradually transfer more of the production process to someone who demonstrates excellent judgment, consistency, and independence.



Our current production budget reaches $1,000/month for broader responsibilities, with the possibility of substantially higher compensation as we grow. However, we don't expect to hand over everything immediately, regardless of experience.



Our compensation structure rewards increasing independence and progressively reduces the need for our involvement over a realistic time. We're investing in a long-term working relationship, not simply hiring someone to complete isolated tasks.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS



• English: C2 (Mastery) or native/bilingual proficiency. Excellent comprehension of conversational English, humor, and nuance. Supporting evidence required.



• Experience: Verifiable podcast or spoken-audio editing experience, including precise dialogue cuts, crossfades, and natural-sounding transitions.



• Software: Experience with DaVinci Resolve or comparable professional editing software. CapCut-only experience does not qualify. All assignments will use DaVinci Resolve.



• Reliability: Proven history of meeting deadlines, communicating consistently, and maintaining long-term client relationships.



This is NOT an entry-level position. Applicants must demonstrate relevant professional experience.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



OUR CONTENT & CREATIVE DIRECTION



Our videos explore astrology, tarot, spirituality, energy work, sound healing, and other esoteric or pseudoscientific subjects.

Your personal relationship with these topics matters to us and this application.



Eventually, you'll need to understand the concepts well enough to identify opportunities for humor, visual storytelling, and creative emphasis. That requires more than simply following editing instructions.



We're looking for someone who genuinely respects and finds value in the material, not someone willing to tolerate it for a paycheck. Over time, a lack of respect for the subject matter can develop into frustration or disengagement, affecting both creative quality and the working relationship.



We want to understand how you personally feel about these subjects because your long-term interest and motivation are important to the success of this role.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



STARTING WORK & DEADLINES (Initial responsibilities are AUDIO ONLY): 



Assignments typically include 1–2 videos weekly, averaging 20–30 minutes each. Volume and video length vary, and no minimum number of assignments is guaranteed.



• Removing filler words, mistakes, and unnecessary pauses

• Cleaning distracting breaths and awkward transitions

• Using precise cuts and crossfades to preserve natural speech



No visual editing is required at this stage.



You'll receive detailed instructional materials, examples, and project specifications. Training focuses on learning our established workflow, not basic editing fundamentals.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



TURNAROUND REQUIREMENTS



• 1 video: Within 24 hours

• 2 videos: Within 48 hours



Assignments are communicated in advance, generally midweek. You will never be expected to do a 24 hour return out of nowhere. Deadlines begin upon receiving complete project materials.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



COMPENSATION & QUALITY STANDARDS



Paid trial: $20 for one 20–30-minute video.

Following a successful trial, audio-only assignments are paid according to the accuracy of the original submission:



• 0–4 revision notes: $40/video

• 5–20 revision notes: $30/video

• 21+ revision notes: $20/video



These rates apply only to the initial audio-cleanup responsibilities.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



ASSIGNMENT & PAYMENT PROCESS



1. Submit: Review your work before delivery and invoice for the $20 base payment.

2. Review: We evaluate your original submission within 2–4 calendar days and identify errors against our instructions.

3. Learn: You'll receive your submitted version alongside our finalized edit. Study the differences and
 a brief summary of what you learned and what you'll apply going forward.

4. Final Payment: Invoice for any remaining quality bonus after completing your review acknowledgment.



Revision notes count editing errors or missed documented requirements, not new creative requests.



LATE DELIVERY DEDUCTIONS (BONUSES ONLY)



• Up to 5 hours late: $5 deduction

• More than 5–12 hours late: $10 deduction

• More than 12–24 hours late: $15 deduction

• Over 24 hours late: No bonus; $20 base only



Deductions never reduce the guaranteed base payment.



Consistent improvement is expected. Repeated mistakes, missed deadlines, or failure to apply previous feedback may result in ending the working relationship.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



LONG-TERM CREATIVE GROWTH



Once you consistently produce accurate audio edits with minimal supervision, we'll begin expanding your responsibilities.

The next stage involves adding simple creative enhancements to videos that are otherwise already assembled:



• Sound effects, GIFs, text, and humor

• Simple animations and visual callouts

• Small creative additions that strengthen the message or improve audience understanding



You won't initially be expected to invent entire concepts or produce complex videos from scratch. The technical tasks themselves are relatively straightforward. The difficult part is developing the judgment to know WHERE an element belongs, WHY it adds something, and WHEN it's better to leave something alone.



Our editing style is specific. Even experienced editors will need time to study it, understand our humor and storytelling, and develop that judgment through feedback.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



EARNING POTENTIAL - NOW



Stage 1 — Audio editing

$20–$40 per video, based on accuracy.



Stage 2 — Audio + creative enhancements

Up to $75 per video, or $150 for a two-video assignment, with consistently excellent work and minimal revisions.



Stage 3 — Expanded production responsibilities

Up to $250 per weekly assignment, potentially including thumbnail/cover art, Shorts, scriptwriting, and other creative tasks.



Much of this work is already templated. The focus is on adding finishing details, creative enhancements, and independent judgment rather than developing every project from scratch.



Our current maximum budget is approximately $1,000 over four weeks when the workload and responsibilities justify it. Compensation remains assignment-based, not a guaranteed monthly retainer.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



FUTURE EARNINGS  ($2 - 3,000 per month) 



Based on our current revenue growth, we believe the production budget could eventually support $2,000–$3,000 per month over the next few years, provided the workload, business growth, and responsibilities justify it. This is a possibility, not guaranteed compensation.



Rather than hiring five different people, we'd prefer to develop one versatile, reliable editor who can gradually take ownership of more of the production process.That requires patience, continuous learning, and mutual trust. In return, we're willing to invest substantially in someone who proves they can take on increasing responsibilities.



We also want compensation to remain an open conversation. As responsibilities expand, new rates will be discussed and agreed upon before additional work is assigned.



We're looking for someone confident enough to communicate directly, raise concerns early, and work through difficult situations rather than avoid them. We value people who can propose solutions, negotiate reasonable compromises, and approach problems constructively.



----------------------------------------------------------------------



TO APPLY — ANSWER ALL FIVE QUESTIONS



1. RELIABILITY

Provide verifiable examples of recurring client work, including the duration of those relationships and your delivery history. How would your current workload allow you to consistently meet our 24–48-hour deadlines over the next 1–2 years or longer? What genuinely interests you about building a long-term working relationship?



2. ENGLISH

Confirm your C2 or native/bilingual proficiency and provide evidence supporting your level of comprehension.



3. EXPERIENCE

Share examples of podcast or spoken-audio editing you've personally completed. Explain your responsibilities, software used, and what specific editing work you performed.



4. CONTENT COMPATIBILITY

What is your personal experience with astrology, tarot, spirituality, energy work, sound healing, or similar subjects? How do you honestly feel about these topics, and could you see yourself enjoying creative work involving them for several years?



We're interested in your actual perspective, including reservations. We'd rather discover an incompatibility now than after both sides have invested substantial time and effort.



5. PROBLEM-SOLVING

Describe a real situation where a client relationship, assignment, or workload became difficult or overwhelming and you had to fix it independently. What happened, how did you handle it, and what was the outcome? We're particularly interested in how you communicate and solve problems when things don't go according to plan or expectation. 



START DATE: JANUARY 1, 2027



We're taking our time to find the right person and have learned from previous hiring experiences that choosing too quickly can be costly for everyone involved.



Thoughtful, specific answers matter more than perfectly polished applications. We're interested in your actual experience, personality, judgment, and ability to communicate honestly—not generic or AI-generated responses.



We don't expect a perfect candidate. We do expect someone who takes the opportunity seriously and demonstrates genuine effort in their application. If you send a templated response with surface level thought, it will likely not be engaged with. 



Thank you for your time!

title: Part-Time B2B Sales & Appointment Setter — US Beauty Wholesale Accounts
description:
Nuovaderm Beauty is seeking an experienced Philippines-based B2B sales and appointment-setting contractor to help build recurring wholesale relationships with US beauty businesses.



We are a US-based authorized Ekai distributor supplying authentic Dr. Pen devices, replacement cartridges and related accessories. We work directly with Ekai, and redacted direct-sourcing documentation is available.



Our customers and prospects include esthetics schools, beauty academies, independent estheticians, spas, salons, educators, beauty-supply stores and specialty retailers.



Our objective is to become a dependable primary or backup US supplier for these businesses. We currently carry Dr. Pen M8S inventory, but this role is not limited to selling one model. You will discover which models, cartridges and accessories each business needs. Other authentic Ekai/Dr. Pen products may be sourced subject to confirmed availability and approved order terms.



PAY AND OPPORTUNITY

Pay is $12–$15 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience, starting at approximately eight hours per week.



This role begins with a two-week paid trial, including an initial two-hour paid checkpoint. At that checkpoint, we will review preparation, outreach execution and documentation before authorizing further hours. All authorized time worked will be paid.



Our goal is to find someone for a consistent, ongoing working relationship. A successful trial may lead to regular weekly work and increased hours as the business grows.



Performance bonuses are available for agreed, measurable results. Bonus amounts and qualification criteria will be agreed in writing before the applicable work begins.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Research and verify relevant US business prospects.

• Work from initial prospect lists and existing outreach records.

• Make professional outbound calls during agreed US business hours.

• Reach owners, educators and purchasing decision-makers.

• Discover current device models, cartridge configurations and accessory needs.

• Understand whether products are used internally, resold or included in student kits.

• Ask about quantities per order and purchasing frequency.

• Learn about supplier concerns, including authenticity, availability, lead time, pricing and support.

• Ask about current or target pricing when appropriate, including whether shipping is included.

• Introduce Nuovaderm as a potential primary or backup supplier.

• Present M8S when it fits the prospect’s needs.

• Document demand for other models without promising unconfirmed sourcing.

• Schedule qualified conversations with the founder, Mercy Arrey.

• Send approved follow-ups.

• Maintain accurate call records, prospect notes and next actions.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Demonstrated B2B cold-calling, appointment-setting or wholesale-sales experience.

• Experience speaking with US business owners and purchasing decision-makers.

• Strong discovery, listening and objection-handling skills.

• Clear, professional, conversational spoken English and strong written English.

• Reliable availability during agreed US business hours, which will generally mean evening or night work in the Philippines.

• Accurate recordkeeping and consistent follow-up.

• Reliable internet, a suitable headset and a quiet calling environment.

• Ability to follow approved pricing and product information.



Beauty, esthetics, spa, salon, education, professional-device or wholesale experience is strongly preferred.



COMMUNICATION STANDARD

You must be able to hold natural conversations with US business owners, understand their answers, ask relevant follow-up questions and explain next steps clearly.



Finalists will demonstrate these skills in a live interview and sales role-play. We assess clarity, listening and effectiveness rather than accent or nationality.



WHAT NUOVADERM PROVIDES

• Target-business criteria and initial prospect lists.

• Approved product and authenticity information.

• Call, voi
 and follow-up guidance.

• Pricing boundaries and approved answers to common questions.

• A prospect and activity tracker.

• Founder support for qualified purchasing conversations.

• Guidance on confirmed availability and sourcing.



WORKING BOUNDARIES

This is individualized business outreach, not mass
 or automated-spam work.



Do not make medical or regulatory claims, invent product facts, promise unconfirmed availability, offer unauthorized discounts or agree to exclusivity.



Keep accurate records and respect requests not to be contacted.



HOW PERFORMANCE IS REVIEWED

We review verified prospect research, outreach execution, decision-makers reached, meaningful conversations, purchasing needs identified, qualified appointments attended, follow-up quality and resulting buying opportunities.



A qualified appointment involves a legitimate US business, an appropriate decision-maker or authorized representative, a relevant purchasing need and genuine agreement to discuss Nuovaderm as a supplier.



We do not require a sale within the initial two-hour checkpoint.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer the application questions below with specific examples from your own experience. A polished résumé alone is not sufficient. Copy each question into your application and answer it.



1. Describe one recent B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting assignment. What did you sell, whom did you call, what did you personally handle and what results followed?

2. What experience do you have reaching US business owners or purchasing decision-makers? Include any beauty, spa, school, device or wholesale experience.

3. Which US business hours can you consistently cover? State the time zone and corresponding Philippine hours.

4. How would you divide eight working hours among preparation, prospect research, calling, documentation and follow-up?

5. A prospect says: “We already have a supplier, we use A6S, and your price is higher.” How would you continue the conversation?

6. How do you document calls and organize follow-ups without contacting prospects excessively?

7. Confirm that you accept the $12–$15/hour range, initial eight-hour weekly schedule, two-week paid trial, two-hour paid checkpoint and live interview/role-play.



Finalists will complete a live interview and the same sales role-play. Any actual prospecting assignment will be paid and begin only after a paid engagement is agreed.

title: Industrial Product Designer / 3D CAD Specialist – Consumer Product Development
description:
Industrial Product Designer / 3D CAD Specialist – Consumer Product Development



Job Type: Project-Based / Freelance  

Location: Remote  

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and project scope



About the Project



I'm developing a premium, luxury golf accessory that I plan to manufacture and sell commercially.



I have already created detailed photorealistic product renderings showing the intended design from multiple angles. I am now looking for an experienced **industrial designer or mechanical CAD specialist** who can transform these renderings into an accurate, professional, and manufacturable 3D CAD model.



This is a real product development project, not simply a 3D rendering exercise.



The product consists primarily of a sculpted hardwood body, custom brass components, and an integrated cleaning brush.



What You'll Be Doing



- Study reference renderings and translate the design into accurate 3D CAD geometry.

- Reconcile inconsistencies between different reference views.

- Preserve the original design's appearance, proportions, curvature, and detailed craftsmanship.

- Develop realistic dimensions, cross-sections, and component relationships.

- Model a sculpted wooden body with curved surfaces and carefully beveled edges.

- Design mounting provisions for brass components, fasteners, and brush bristles.

- Identify potential manufacturing challenges and recommend practical solutions.

- Prepare editable CAD files and professional technical drawings for prototyping and eventual manufacturing.



Required Qualifications



- Strong experience with SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or comparable professional CAD software.

- Experience with industrial design, mechanical design, or physical consumer product development.

- Strong ability to create complex curved surfaces, sculpted bodies, and precise solid models.

- Understanding of materials, mechanical connections, assembly methods, and manufacturing constraints.

- Ability to translate product images and concept renderings into physically realistic 3D models.

- Attention to detail and the ability to preserve the aesthetics of an existing design.



**Experience with CNC machining, woodworking, metal components, or luxury consumer products is a major plus.**



Project Deliverables



The project will be divided into two stages.



Stage 1 — Exterior Design and 3D Modeling



- Develop a precise 3D model from the provided reference images.

- Establish consistent dimensions and geometry.

- Reproduce the original sculpted shape and overall appearance as closely as practical.

- Provide multiple views of the model for review.

- Make agreed-upon revisions until the exterior design is approved.

- Deliver the editable native CAD model and STEP file.



Stage 2 — Detailed Engineering and Manufacturing Preparation**



- Finalize individual component geometry and mounting details.

- Develop the product assembly.

- Produce dimensioned engineering drawings and cross-sections.

- Prepare native CAD, STEP, and STL files.

- Identify any unresolved manufacturing or prototyping requirements.



The initial contract will focus on Stage 1. Stage 2 may be awarded after satisfactory completion of the first stage.



Important Design Requirement



I am very particular about preserving the original product's appearance.



I do not want someone who will simplify the design into a generic shape just because it is easier to model.



The ideal candidate can balance aesthetics, mechanical accuracy, and manufacturability.



I will provide all available reference images, preliminary dimensions, and previous design notes.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A portfolio showing **3D CAD models of actual physical products** you have designed, preferably including curved or sculpted surfaces.

2. Which CAD software you use and your level of experience with it.

3. Examples of any products you've designed that were successfully prototyped or manufactured.

4. Your estimated price and timeline for Stage 1.

5. A brief explanation of how you would approach converting product renderings into accurate, manufacturable CAD geometry.



Please begin your application with the words "Golf Product CAD" so I know you've read the full description.**



I'm looking for someone who can deliver high-quality work and potentially collaborate on additional product development projects in the future.

title: Sales & Procurement Coordinator
description:
About Q Engineering



Q Engineering is a Canadian engineering and building design consulting firm specializing in residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and infrastructure projects. We provide integrated engineering and building design services, including architectural design, structural engineering, mechanical (HVAC), civil/grading, interior design, shop drawings, and permit coordination. Our multidisciplinary team works collaboratively to deliver innovative, practical, and code-compliant solutions from concept through permit approval and construction support.



Role Overview



As a Sales & Procurement Coordinator, you will support Q Engineering's business development, client relationship management, and procurement activities. This role is approximately 50% Sales and 50% Procurement & CRM, combining B2B sales outreach and CRM coordination with vendor, consultant, and procurement support.



You will be responsible for identifying and following up on potential business opportunities, maintaining accurate CRM records, supporting client communications, researching consultants and vendors, requesting and tracking quotations, maintaining vendor and partner information, and assisting with procurement documentation and comparisons.



This is a fully remote position requiring strong English communication, organization, online research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently during Q Engineering's required Ontario working hours.



Key Responsibilities



Sales & CRM



Conduct B2B sales outreach and follow up with prospective and existing clients.

Research potential clients, markets, business opportunities, and industry contacts.

Support lead generation, prospecting, and business development activities.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date client, lead, and opportunity information in the CRM system.

Track sales activities, follow-ups, communications, and opportunity status.

Coordinate follow-up communications with prospective clients and business contacts.

Assist with preparing and organizing sales-related information, presentations, proposals, and supporting documentation.

Maintain organized records of client communications and business development activities.

Support management with sales pipeline tracking and CRM reporting.

Coordinate internally to ensure client inquiries and sales opportunities are followed up in a timely and professional manner.

Procurement & Vendor Coordination



Research qualified consultants, vendors, suppliers, and potential business partners based on project and operational requirements.

Request quotations and required information from consultants, vendors, and suppliers.

Follow up on outstanding quotations, information, and procurement documentation.

Maintain and update Q Engineering's consultant, vendor, supplier, and partner database.

Prepare organized quotation comparisons for management review.

Maintain RFQ tracking records, including request dates, responses, follow-ups, quotation status, and related documentation.

Collect and organize required procurement documents, qualifications, company information, and supporting records from potential consultants and vendors.

Assist with maintaining complete and accurate procurement records and supporting documentation.

Coordinate procurement-related communications and follow-ups with internal team members and external parties.

Support management in obtaining sufficient information and documentation for vendor and consultant evaluations.

Assist with other procurement and coordination activities as required.

Authority Limitation: The Sales & Procurement Coordinator supports procurement activities and provides research, coordination, documentation, and follow-up assistance. This position does not have authority to make final vendor or consultant selections, conduct or approve major negotiations, determine fees, approve commercial terms, or make commitments on behalf of Q Engineering without appropriate management approval.



Skills & Qualifications



Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related business field.

Education or background in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related technical field is considered an asset.

Previous experience in B2B sales, business development, sales coordination, procurement coordination, vendor management, CRM administration, or a related role.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Experience using CRM systems to maintain leads, contacts, opportunities, follow-ups, and sales records.

Experience with Zoho CRM is preferred but not mandatory.

Strong B2B prospecting, outreach, and follow-up skills.

Experience researching vendors, consultants, suppliers, prospective clients, or business opportunities online.

Ability to request, track, organize, and compare quotations and supporting documentation.

Strong organizational, administrative, and record-management skills.

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple follow-ups, deadlines, and priorities.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office and cloud-based collaboration tools.

Ability to communicate professionally with clients, consultants, vendors, suppliers, and internal team members.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and maintain productivity in a fully remote environment.

Engineering, construction, architecture, building design, or other technical industry experience is considered a preferred asset but is not mandatory.

Must be available to work during Q Engineering's required Ontario working hours.

Working Conditions



Hours of work: 40+ hours per week or as agreed in the engagement agreement.

Work Environment: Fully remote position using Microsoft Teams and cloudbased collaboration tools.

Special conditions or requirements: Reliable high-speed internet, professional home office, ability to maintain confidentiality, and availability during agreed working hours.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI): Q Engineering is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive professional environment.

Evaluation and Review: Performance will be evaluated based on drawing quality, technical accuracy, coordination, productivity, communication, and meeting agreed project deadlines.

Q Engineering – Professional Standards & Engagement Requirements



The Sales & Procurement Coordinator is expected to maintain accurate and organized sales, CRM, vendor, consultant, and procurement records while providing timely and professional coordination with clients, prospective clients, consultants, vendors, suppliers, and internal team members.



Individuals engaged in this role are expected to maintain high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, communication, accuracy, responsiveness, organization, and productivity while complying with Q Engineering's internal procedures and agreed-upon responsibilities. Procurement activities must be conducted within the authority assigned to the position, and final vendor or consultant selection, major negotiations, fee decisions, commercial commitments, and other binding decisions require appropriate management approval.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python/Django)
description:
Company: US-Based SaaS Startup

Position: Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | Long-Term

Bonus: 13th-Month Bonus

Schedule: Flexible – Work Normal Philippine Daytime Hours (No Overnight US Shift)



**About the Opportunity**



We're a US-based software company building a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform that connects accounting, customer relationships, operations, workflows, and other essential business functions into one integrated system. After 18 months of development, we're looking for our first external software engineer to help complete our MVP, improve existing functionality, and prepare the product for launch. You'll work directly with a technical founder who leads the overall product vision and architecture, while taking ownership of meaningful development work. We're looking for someone who doesn't just write code to make something work, but thinks critically about how to build scalable, flexible, and maintainable systems that can evolve as the product grows.



**What You'll Do**



• Full-Stack Development: Build and improve features across our Django backend, PostgreSQL database, and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend.

• Scalable System Design: Develop reusable, configurable, and extensible solutions rather than relying on hardcoded logic or short-term workarounds.

• Feature Ownership: Independently take features from requirements through implementation, testing, and completion.

• Architecture & Problem-Solving: Understand how different modules interact, anticipate edge cases, and recommend thoughtful technical solutions.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Assist with AWS deployments, environment configuration, CI/CD processes, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

• Quality & Performance: Debug complex issues, optimize queries and application performance, write automated tests, and improve security and reliability.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with the founder to evaluate approaches, identify improvements, and help prepare the platform for production.



**Our Tech Stack**



• Backend: Python, Django

• Database: PostgreSQL

• Frontend: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JavaScript

• Testing: pytest

• Background Tasks: Celery, Redis

• Infrastructure & DevOps: AWS, Git, CI/CD, deployment and monitoring tools

• Other: REST APIs, third-party integrations



**What We're Looking For**



• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on Python/Django expertise.

• Strong knowledge of Django architecture, PostgreSQL, relational database design, and query optimization.

• Comfortable building interactive interfaces using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

• Experience designing scalable, dynamic, and maintainable systems with reusable components and configurable business logic.

• Ability to understand and extend existing complex codebases without introducing unnecessary complexity or technical debt.

• Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals, cloud deployments, and production application troubleshooting.

• Strong debugging, problem-solving, testing, and performance optimization skills.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and make sound technical decisions with minimal supervision.

• Proactive communication, attention to detail, and good written and spoken English.



**Nice to Have**



• Experience building ERP, CRM, SaaS, or other business management platforms.

• Experience with AG Grid, particularly advanced data tables, filtering, editing, and dynamic data-driven interfaces.

• Experience with Celery, Redis, background processing, and API integrations.

• Stronger AWS, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or application monitoring experience.

• Experience helping bring early-stage software products into production.



**Why Join Us**



• Meaningful Ownership: Take responsibility for important features and contribute to how the product is built.

• Work With a Technical Founder: Collaborate directly with someone who understands software development and values thoughtful engineering.

• Interesting Technical Challenges: Build interconnected systems with complex business workflows, dynamic interfaces, and evolving requirements.

• Flexible Working Hours: Work during normal Philippine daytime hours. No overnight US shift required.

• Long-Term Growth: Join early and have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities as the product and engineering team expand.



**How to Apply**



1. Your resume/CV and a brief overview of your Python/Django experience.

2. Your GitHub, portfolio, or examples of relevant projects, if available.

3. A brief example of a complex feature or system you independently designed or developed. How did you make it scalable, flexible, or maintainable rather than relying on hardcoded solutions?

4. Your expected monthly salary (USD) and earliest availability.



We're looking for a thoughtful, dependable engineer who takes pride in building quality software, solves problems independently, and thinks beyond simply completing assigned tasks. If you enjoy building well-designed systems and want to make a meaningful impact on a growing software product, we'd love to hear from you.
