title: Research & Quality Director (Law Practice and Journalism / Data Quality) - Remote, US Firm
description:
US lawfirm and media company that turns public-records responses into clean, searchable data seeks a REMOTE Research & Quality Director based in the Philippines.



An Example of the Legal Tasks

 - Reviewing filings and file names

 - Reviewing responses and software indicated values for lawsuit feasibility



An Example of the Data Cleaning task:

 - Software reads thousands of pages of
s, letters and scanned policies and pulls out facts. A person has to d
 whether those facts are right. That person is you.



THE JOB (you will be provided a Claude account)

- Check machine-extracted facts against the original pages and d
 what is right, wrong or unclear.

- Write down, in plain rules, how borderline cases get d
, so the next reviewer d
 the same way.

- D
 when the way we organize the data is missing something, and say exactly what to add and why.

- Measure accuracy by sampling, and report it honestly, including what you do not know yet.

- Train and supervise a small team of reviewers as we grow.



GOOD FIT

You have worked as with technical tools and data before. Checking a claim against its source is your daily habit. You do NOT need to code. You do need to understand, in general terms, how people check and improve automated systems that read documents: what a label is, why you test on examples the system has not seen, why one accuracy number can mislead.



WE LOOK FOR

- Strong written English (you will write a short reason for every decision)

- A habit of opening the source before accepting a claim

- Comfort with spreadsheets and counting things carefully

- Patience with messy documents: scans, forms, long policy manuals

- Good judgement about when to d
 and when to ask

Nice to have: public-records or court documents, labelling/reviewing data for AI, legal or policy background.



THE POSITION

40 hours per week - London afternnon hours 1pm-9pm)

Remote

$500/mo

Availability on WhatsApp

Reports to the founder and the UK team. The documents contain confidential and personal information: you will keep everything confidential and work only inside our tools.



TO APPLY (we read your answers BEFORE your CV)

Send your CV and answer each question in ONE paragraph, in your own words, no more than 180 words each:



1) A system read 200 documents and extracted 2,000 facts. You check 50 of them against the pages and find 6 wrong. What do you conclude about the other 1,950? What would you do next, and what would you tell your manager?



2) You fix the system's mistakes on 30 documents. It now gets all 30 right, and a colleague says the problem is solved. What is wrong with that conclusion, and how would you check?



3) A system keeps marking a yes/no field "yes" whenever a document merely mentions the topic. You can only change the written instruction it is given. Write the new instruction in two or three sentences, and say how you would test that it works without breaking something else.



4) To save money, a program skips about 40% of the pages in very long manuals because they do not mention the topic. How would you find out whether it is skipping pages that matter, and what would you do with the answer?



5) Tell me why ClaudeCode is better than a traditional AI chat tool?



Shortlisted applicants do a short paid trial task of 2 to 3 hours and a five-minute follow-up call about their own answers. We hire on whether you ask a question when a case is ambiguous, not on speed.

title: Senior Government Contracting Specialist – Micro-Purchases & Small Federal Contracts
description:
**EXPERIENCED PROFESSIONALS ONLY – MANDATORY PAID SKILLS TRIAL**



### ABOUT THE COMPANY





We are seeking a **highly experienced Government Contracting Specialist who can independently manage the entire federal contracting process from A to Z.**



Our company is transitioning toward federal micro-purchases, simplified acquisitions, and smaller, manageable government contracts, particularly in service-based industries.



We are NOT interested in pursuing large, complicated projects at this time.



We need an experienced professional who knows how to find opportunities, evaluate profitability, secure subcontractors, prepare quotations, communicate with government buyers, coordinate awards, and manage contract execution.



**This is NOT an entry-level virtual assistant position.**



### WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who has personally managed government contracts from beginning to end.



We are NOT looking for someone who has only:



- Searched SAM.gov for opportunities.

- Assisted another government contracting specialist.

- Prepared portions of proposals.

- Performed administrative tasks.

- Worked on one phase of the contracting process.

- Completed government contracting training without significant hands-on experience.



**We need someone who has actually DONE the work, understands the entire process, and can take ownership without constant supervision.**



The ideal candidate is confident, proactive, resourceful, organized, and capable of solving problems independently.



### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



**1. Government Contract Research & Opportunity Identification**



- Independently identify federal micro-purchases, simplified acquisitions, and smaller government contracting opportunities.

- Research opportunities through SAM.gov, agency procurement websites, small-purchase portals, and other federal procurement resources.

- Identify opportunities aligned with our company's capabilities and certifications.

- Develop relationships with government buyers and purchasing departments.

- Perform preliminary go/no-go evaluations without requiring owner involvement in every decision.

- Prioritize opportunities that are realistic, manageable, and profitable.

- Maintain an organized pipeline of potential contracts.



**2. Subcontractor & Vendor Sourcing**



- Independently locate qualified U.S.-based subcontractors, suppliers, and service providers.

- Contact vendors directly by phone and
.

- Request and obtain competitive pricing.

- Negotiate pricing and service terms when appropriate.

- Verify vendor qualifications, availability, reliability, and ability to perform.

- Coordinate subcontractor requirements and timelines.

- Build and maintain a dependable subcontractor and supplier network.



**You must be comfortable making phone calls and conducting business directly with U.S. vendors and government personnel.**



**3. Pricing, Profitability & Go/No-Go Analysis**



- Review solicitation requirements and determine feasibility.

- Obtain vendor and subcontractor pricing.

- Calculate estimated expenses, overhead, and profit margins.

- Identify potential risks before pursuing opportunities.

- Independently conduct preliminary go/no-go assessments.

- Present only well-researched, viable opportunities to ownership.

- Provide clear recommendations supported by actual numbers.



We do not want to review dozens of opportunities that have not been properly researched.



**We want someone who can identify which opportunities make business sense before bringing them to us.**



**4. Bid Preparation & Submission**



- Review RFQs, solicitations, and procurement requirements.

- Prepare complete and accurate quotations and proposals.

- Coordinate pricing and supporting documentation.

- Ensure submissions meet applicable federal procurement requirements.

- Prepare all necessary forms and supporting materials.

- Submit bids and quotations after receiving required company authorization.

- Track submissions and follow up with contracting officers.



**5. Contract Award & Execution Management**



- Coordinate awarded contracts from beginning to completion.

- Communicate with subcontractors, vendors, and government contacts.

- Monitor contract deliverables and performance deadlines.

- Ensure subcontractors understand their responsibilities.

- Address routine operational issues independently.

- Coordinate documentation, invoicing, and payment tracking.

- Assist with contract closeout and performance follow-up.



We want someone who understands that winning the contract is only part of the job. Successful execution and profitability are equally important.



**6. Independent Daily Operations**



- Manage the daily contracting workflow without constant instructions.

- Establish and maintain organized systems for opportunities, vendors, quotes, deadlines, and awards.

- Follow up on outstanding quotations and submissions.

- Proactively identify and resolve problems.

- Communicate with vendors and contracting personnel independently.

- Provide concise progress reports.

- Keep ownership informed of important decisions, risks, and opportunities.



### OUR EXPECTATIONS – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



**We are seeking an experienced professional, NOT someone who requires constant hand-holding.**



We understand that business owners must remain involved in important decisions. However, we do not have the availability to answer dozens of routine questions throughout the day.



We expect the person hired to already know how to perform government contracting work.



**You must be able to:**



- Take initiative without waiting for instructions.

- Research answers before asking questions.

- Solve routine problems independently.

- Find subcontractors and obtain pricing without being prompted.

- Evaluate opportunities and provide recommendations.

- Manage multiple contracting activities efficiently.

- Make sound preliminary business assessments.

- Present solutions rather than simply identifying problems.

- Work independently while maintaining accountability.



We expect ownership to be involved primarily in strategic decisions, final bid approvals, financial commitments, contractual signatures, and significant issues.



**Our goal is to hire someone who can RUN the day-to-day contracting operation, not someone who needs us to manage every step.**



### REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS



- Proven experience managing U.S. federal government contracts from opportunity identification through contract completion.

- Direct hands-on experience with federal micro-purchases and simplified acquisitions.

- Strong working knowledge of SAM.gov and other federal procurement resources.

- Understanding of FAR requirements, RFQs, solicitations, and federal purchasing procedures.

- Proven ability to independently source U.S. subcontractors and suppliers.

- Experience obtaining vendor quotes, analyzing costs, and determining profitability.

- Experience preparing and submitting compliant government quotations and proposals.

- Experience communicating directly with U.S. contracting officers and vendors.

- Strong spoken and written English.

- Excellent organization, time management, and problem-solving skills.

title: (Tiktok/Reel Only) Experienced Video Editor
description:
I’m looking for a reliable editor to turn gaming footage into short vertical videos with interesting titles and publish them on agreed social accounts.



I will provide a ZIP file containing video clips, a tutorial showing the process, and finished examples. You will watch the supplied clips, choose good moments, and turn them into finished videos.



This is a small role paid per approved clip. It does not offer a full-time salary, guaranteed hours, or a guaranteed number of clips each month.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Download and watch the supplied footage.

- Choose funny, surprising, or interesting moments.

- Edit each moment into a short vertical video.

- Remove unnecessary pauses and make the moment easy to follow.

- Write a clear, attention-grabbing title that accurately matches the clip.

- Follow this layout: Grimm at the top, title across the middle, gameplay below.

- Use black title text on a white box, like the examples in the tutorial.

- Publish finished clips on the social accounts agreed with me.

- Include the game’s hashtag and #GrimmHollywood. You can add other relevant hashtags to help people find the clip.

- Save your published post links and log view counts in our private website.

- Use the website’s messaging system to ask questions and discuss your work.

Post no more than two clips per day. If posting two, post one in the morning and one in the evening, several hours apart, using Pacific time zone. Two clips is the daily maximum, not a requirement to post every day.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR

- Experience editing short vertical videos.

- An understanding of gaming clips and what makes a moment interesting.

- The ability to write clear English titles.

- The ability to follow a tutorial and match supplied examples.

- Reliable communication and delivery by agreed deadlines.

You may use the editing software you prefer, provided you can produce the required result.



STEP 1 — APPLICATION SAMPLE



I will send you a sample ZIP, my tutorial, and finished examples.



Please create one or two finished sample clips, each with its own title.



One clip is enough to apply. A second clip is optional. Please do not make more than two.



For your application:

1. Watch the tutorial.

2. Download and unzip the sample footage.

3. Choose your moment or moments.

4. Edit the clip or clips using the example layout.

5. Write a title for each clip.

6. Export each finished clip as an MP4.

7. Send me a private download link that I can open.

Include a suggested posting caption for each clip, with the game’s hashtag and #GrimmHollywood. Other relevant hashtags are welcome.



The application samples are unpaid. They let me review your editing, titles, and ability to follow instructions. Completing them does not mean you have been hired or guarantee that you will be selected.



Do not publish the samples on social media. You will not need access to our website or social accounts during the application.



STEP 2 — PAID TRIAL



If your application samples are a good fit, I will invite you to a paid trial.



Before you start, we will agree on the trial length, workload, deadlines, payment terms, and bonus limits. You will receive the website and account access needed for the work.



During the trial, you will:

- Choose moments from the footage I provide.

- Edit clips and write titles using the tutorial and examples.

- Make changes based on my feedback.

- Publish approved clips on the agreed accounts.

- Save post links and log view counts in our website.

- Communicate clearly and meet agreed deadlines.

I will review your editing, titles, reliability, and ability to follow instructions. Trial work is paid under the agreed terms.



If we both want to continue, we will move into ongoing paid work. Completing the trial does not guarantee an ongoing position.



STEP 3 — ONGOING PAID WORK



If we both want to continue after the paid trial, you will handle the regular clipping and posting process: review footage, choose moments, edit clips, write titles, publish, and record post links and views.



I will continue providing footage and feedback. We will agree on your workload and deadlines, and you will use our private website to track your work and communicate with me.



The maximum remains two published clips per day, several hours apart.



This is ongoing work paid per clip. It does not guarantee full-time hours or a fixed number of clips each month.



PAYMENT FOR THE PAID TRIAL AND ONGOING WORK



All payments are in US dollars (USD), paid through PayPal. You must have a PayPal account that can receive payments.

- US$1 per approved clip.

- Posting the same edit on several agreed platforms earns one base editing fee, not a separate editing fee for each platform.

- US$0.05 per 1,000 eligible views during each post’s first 14 days.

- Views earned after that post’s 14-day window do not earn additional payment.

- Bonuses are capped. The exact per-clip and combined monthly bonus limits will be agreed in writing before paid work starts.

- Payment dates and responsibility for any PayPal fees will also be agreed before paid work starts.

- View bonuses are checked against recorded view counts and evidence before payment. The end of a post’s 14-day window is not automatically its payment date.

The unpaid application samples are separate from the paid trial and ongoing work.



REGULAR WORKLOAD, BASE PAY, AND VIEW BONUSES



I normally stream three times per week: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. You will create three finished clips from each stream, giving you approximately nine clips per week.



Base pay



You earn US$1 per approved clip, regardless of how many views it receives. Completing the regular workload gives you approximately US$36–45 per month in base pay.



Posting the same edit on several platforms earns one base editing fee. Additional clips requested and approved by me are paid at the same rate.



Extra money from views



On top of your base pay, you can earn a performance bonus of US$0.05 per 1,000 eligible views during each post’s first 14 days.



For example, before applying the combined monthly limit:

- 10,000 eligible views: US$0.50 bonus.

- 100,000 eligible views: US$5 bonus.

- 200,000 eligible views: US$10 bonus—the maximum bonus for one clip.

Eligible views from the agreed platform posts of the same clip count toward that clip’s bonus.



The bonus limits are:

- Up to US$10 per clip, across its agreed platform posts.

- Up to US$40 total in bonuses for all clips in one month, not US$40 for each clip.

With the regular workload, that means approximately US$36–45 in base pay, plus up to US$40 in view bonuses—a possible total of US$76–85 per month if the full monthly bonus is earned.



Bonuses depend on actual eligible views and are not guaranteed. Views after each post’s first 14 days do not earn additional payment. You will log post links and view counts in our website so I can check them before payment.



All payments are in USD through PayPal.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send the following with your application:

- Your name.

- Your availability.

- The editing software you use.

- Links to previous edits, if you have them.

- Confirmation that you can receive payments through PayPal.

I will then send the sample ZIP, tutorial, examples, and submission deadline.



Remember: one application clip is enough. A second is optional. Application samples are unpaid.



If anything is unclear, ask before you start.

title: Virtual Assistant – Mental Health Practice
description:
Virtual Assistant – Mental Health Practice



Embrace Your Mind and Wellness, LLC



Remote | Philippines-Based | Part-Time | 15–20 Hours Weekly | $4–$5 USD/Hour



About Our Practice



Embrace Your Mind and Wellness, LLC is a growing U.S.-based outpatient psychiatric mental health practice serving patients in New York and New Jersey through telehealth and in-person services.



We are seeking an experienced, dependable, detail-oriented Medical Virtual Assistant to provide administrative, documentation, and operational support.



The ideal candidate has previous experience supporting U.S.-based psychiatric providers, behavioral health practices, or multi-provider medical groups.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative, communicates proactively, follows through on assigned responsibilities, and can work independently without requiring constant reminders or supervision.



This is intended to be a long-term opportunity, with potential for increased hours and responsibilities as the practice expands.



Key Responsibilities



1. Patient Scheduling and Intake Coordination



* Follow up on all new patient bookings and inquiries within 24 hours, preferably sooner during scheduled working hours.

* Send intake paperwork, consent forms, appointment instructions, and reminders.

* Review upcoming appointments to identify missing forms, incomplete registrations, or outstanding administrative requirements.

* Follow up with patients regarding incomplete paperwork before appointments.

* Collect and securely upload identification, insurance cards, and required documents into the appropriate EHR.

* Assist with scheduling, rescheduling, cancellations, and appointment confirmations.

* Monitor Zocdoc bookings and coordinate patient intake across practice platforms.

* Maintain accurate scheduling records and proactively communicate appointment-related concerns to the provider.



2. Psychiatric Documentation and EHR Support



* Assist with preparing psychiatric intake and medication-management follow-up notes based on clinician-provided information.

* Organize clinical documentation using approved templates and established practice guidelines.

* Review administrative documentation queues and identify missing or incomplete notes.

* Notify the provider of outstanding documentation requiring clinical review or signature.

* Update EHR templates, intake forms, and administrative workflows as directed.

* Ensure documentation tasks are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

* Maintain clear tracking of pending and completed documentation tasks.



All clinical notes must be reviewed and approved by the licensed provider. The VA will not independently assess patients, make treatment decisions, or alter clinical findings.



3. Insurance Verification, Prior Authorizations, and Billing Support



* Verify patient insurance eligibility, benefits, copayments, deductibles, and coverage requirements.

* Complete administrative portions of medication prior authorization requests and follow up with pharmacies and insurance companies.

* Maintain a tracking system for pending, approved, and denied authorizations.

* Coordinate with the billing team regarding outstanding claims, payment discrepancies, and denials.

* Monitor unresolved billing issues and provide timely updates.

* Prepare monthly reports summarizing outstanding claims, denials, and follow-up actions.

* Escalate insurance or authorization issues that may affect patient access to treatment.



4. Patient Communication and Administrative Support



* Monitor designated practice
, phone, and messaging platforms during assigned hours.

* Respond to routine administrative questions using approved practice communication guidelines.

* Communicate professionally, respectfully, and compassionately with patients.

* Maintain organized records, spreadsheets, and administrative tracking systems.

* Coordinate referrals, medical records requests, and routine provider communications.

* Route clinical questions, medication concerns, urgent messages, and safety-related issues promptly to the appropriate licensed clinician according to established protocols.



5. Practice Organization and Daily Operations



* Maintain an organized daily task list with clear priorities and deadlines.

* Proactively identify outstanding tasks, upcoming deadlines, scheduling gaps, and administrative issues.

* Provide brief daily updates summarizing completed work, pending items, and matters requiring provider attention.

* Follow through on assigned tasks without repeated reminders.

* Communicate any delays, barriers, or questions as soon as they arise.

* Assist with developing and maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs).

* Support administrative workflow improvements and practice growth initiatives.

* Assist with approved social media scheduling and basic marketing tasks when primary responsibilities are completed.



Required Qualifications



* Minimum 2 years of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant or U.S. healthcare administrative professional.

* Strong preference for direct experience supporting psychiatrists, psychiatric nurse practitioners, therapists, or behavioral health practices.

* Experience with psychiatric documentation, medical scribing, or EHR chart preparation.

* Working knowledge of U.S. healthcare administration, insurance verification, and medication prior authorizations.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions, retain established workflows, and work independently.

* Reliable communication and consistent follow-through.

* Comfortable receiving constructive feedback and applying it to future tasks.

* Strong computer skills and proficiency with spreadsheets,
, and online administrative systems.

* Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet private workspace, and appropriate equipment for secure remote work.

* Commitment to patient confidentiality, HIPAA-compliant procedures, required training, and applicable confidentiality or business associate agreements.



Preferred Software Experience



Direct experience with one or more of the following systems is highly preferred:



* OptiMantra – EHR and practice management

* SimplePractice – Telehealth and practice management

* Zocdoc – Patient bookings and intake coordination

* MDToolbox – Electronic prescribing and medication-related administrative workflows

* Headway – Patient intake, insurance, and billing coordination

* Spruce Health – Patient communication and messaging



Experience with psychiatric EHR systems, electronic prescribing workflows, medication prior authorizations, and insurance portals is a significant advantage.



Candidates should identify which platforms they have used and their level of proficiency.



Communication and Performance Expectations



We place significant importance on dependability, communication, and accountability.



The selected candidate must be able to:



* Communicate proactively instead of waiting to be asked for updates.

* Acknowledge assigned tasks and provide clear status updates.

* Consistently complete work within agreed-upon timeframes.

* Ask for clarification when instructions are unclear rather than making assumptions.

* Identify and report errors promptly.

* Demonstrate improvement after receiving feedback.

* Manage multiple administrative priorities effectively.

* Maintain professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive psychiatric patient information.

* Work independently while keeping the provider informed of important developments.



We value someone who is resourceful, organized, trustworthy, and genuinely invested in supporting a well-run practice.



Schedule and Compensation

This is not a sit-and-wait inbox job. You start the conversations. Every new follower on our Instagram gets a friendly hello from you, and you turn those chats, plus the DMs people send us ("How much is an oil change?", "My check engine light is on", "Do you work on BMWs?"), into booked appointments at one of our two shops.



WHERE THE NEW FOLLOWERS COME FROM

We're launching this as a new program, and we're putting real money behind it. We have a dedicated monthly Instagram ad budget for both shops and a set of reels filmed in our own shops, ready for the first few months. We're a small team, not a big production house. We're giving this program 3 to 6 months to prove itself. If it works, we'll keep investing in more content and ads, and you'll grow with it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Send a friendly, personal hello to every new follower and start a conversation

- Answer every Instagram DM, plus comments that need a reply, during your shift

- Follow our DM guide and approved answers. You never make up prices or promises

- Ask the right questions (what car, what's wrong, which shop is closer) and book the appointment

- Pass anything you can't answer to our service advisors

- Keep a simple daily log: new followers greeted, conversations started, appointments booked



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent written English: warm, clear, never pushy

- Proactive. You start conversations instead of waiting for them, and you reply fast

- At least 1 year in chat support, appointment setting or social media DMs

- Reliable internet, plus a backup for brownouts and outages

- Nice to have: basic Spanish (many of our customers speak it)

- Nice to have: some car knowledge. Not required, we'll train you



SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, with a 1-hour lunch break (40 hours a week). In Philippine time that's 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM (8:00 PM to 5:00 AM from mid-March to early November, when the US is on daylight saving time). This is a night shift in the Philippines.



PAY

- $350 USD per month base, paid twice a month

- $15 for every NEW customer you book who shows up for their appointment

- $20 each for every new customer after your 40th in a month

- $5 for every returning customer you book who shows up

- +$15 bonus when a new customer's first visit is $600 or more

- No cap. The more people you help, the more you earn



WHAT YOU COULD EARN (new customers only, before bonuses)

- 20 new customers a month: $650

- 40 new customers a month: $950

- 60 new customers a month: $1,350



Every booking is tracked in our shop system, so your commission is clear and easy to check. You start with a 2-week paid trial.



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application. To be considered:

1. Put "Check engine light" in your subject line (so we know you read this far)

2. Tell us about your chat, DM or appointment-setting experience in a few sentences

3. Write how you would reply to this DM: "hey how much to fix my AC? it's blowing hot air"

4. Optional but recommended: attach a 1-minute voice or video intro



Applications without the subject line won't be reviewed.

title: Ecommerce Video Editor for Meta ads
description:
We are a fast-growing eCommerce company doing 6 figures a month, selling health and beauty products to a 45+ audience through direct-response funnels.



We are currently active in 4 markets across Europe and are expanding into new markets over time.



Our traffic comes from Meta ads, so high-performing video creatives are one of the most important parts of our business.



We are looking for a skilled video editor who can help us create, edit, adapt and test different types of video ads.



This includes everything from UGC-style ads, B-roll videos with voiceovers, AI-generated video ads, product demonstrations and variations of existing winning ads.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



Your main responsibility will be creating and editing video ads for
 and Instagram.



You will:



- Edit short-form direct-response video ads for Meta campaigns

- Create B-roll-based video ads using voiceovers, stock footage, product visuals and other relevant clips

- Combine voiceovers, captions, B-roll, music and sound effects into engaging video ads

- Edit AI-generated video footage and combine it with real footage when needed

- Translate or adapt existing video ads for different countries and languages

- Create new variations of existing winning video ads

- Adapt ads for different products, marketing angles and target audiences

- Add engaging hooks, captions, transitions, product shots and call-to-action sections

- Follow scripts, storyboards, creative briefs and examples provided by our team

- Improve video pacing, storytelling and visual flow to keep viewers engaged

- Make changes and improvements based on feedback

- Export finished videos in the correct formats for Meta campaigns



The type of editing will vary depending on the task.



Some videos will be simple B-roll edits with a voiceover and captions. Others may involve combining multiple types of footage, editing UGC content or working with AI-generated visuals.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable working with different video styles rather than specialising in just one.



HOW WE WORK



We are an eCommerce business using:



- Funnel-based selling

- Direct-response marketing

- Weekly creative testing for all of our products across multiple markets

- Fast product launches

- Structured workflows and clear instructions



In some cases, your task will be straightforward. For example, you may only need to translate an existing winning video ad into another language, replace the voiceover, update the captions and adjust a few visuals.



In other cases, you will receive a detailed creative brief that explains:



- The product and target audience

- The marketing angle and main message

- The hook and video structure

- The script

- The types of footage and visuals needed

- Examples of the editing style we want



Your job will be to turn these instructions into a clean, engaging video ad that is ready to launch and test.



At the beginning, our priority is finding someone who can follow our instructions, references and creative briefs very accurately.



Once you understand our style, audience and creative testing process, we are happy to give you more freedom to suggest your own improvements and creative ideas.



HOURLY WORK, PRODUCTIVITY TARGETS & DEADLINES



We work on an hourly basis, but we also set clear time targets for how long different types of tasks should take.



These targets help you understand how much time to allocate to each task, allowing you to plan and organise your working day in the way that suits you best.



We believe in giving you flexibility over how you structure your day, as long as you manage your workload efficiently and consistently deliver your work on time.



When a creative brief is provided, we expect you to plan your work accordingly and not leave everything until the day before the deadline.



The goal of these time targets is to give you the freedom to manage your own schedule while ensuring that every creative is completed before its deadline, without compromising on quality.



TOOLS WE PROVIDE



We provide access to the tools needed to create and edit our video ads.



For video editing, we can provide access to 
 (for adding accurate subtitles in foreign languages).



For AI-assisted video creation and visual production, we provide access to tools such as Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, Magnific and ElevenLabs.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is experienced in video editing, reliable, detail-oriented and has a good understanding of what makes an advertisement engaging.



You should be:



- Experienced in editing short-form video content

- Experienced editing Meta video ads

- Skilled at combining B-roll footage, voiceovers, captions and sound effects

- Able to create videos that look natural, engaging and professional

- Good at selecting footage that matches the script and message

- Able to edit videos with strong hooks, engaging pacing and smooth visual flow

- Comfortable working with UGC-style and direct-response video formats

- Able to follow detailed instructions and references accurately

- Able to produce multiple variations of the same video concept

- Able to stay organised and manage multiple editing tasks

- Reliable, deadline-focused and responsive to feedback

- Willing to learn new tools and editing techniques when needed



Important: This is not simply a role where you make videos look visually attractive.



We create videos to sell products.



That means understanding how to capture attention in the first few seconds, keep people watching, match the visuals to the voiceover and deliver a clear message.



You should be open to learning about marketing and why videos work. We will provide the scripts, angles, examples and instructions.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Part-time work to start

- Opportunity to grow into a full-time position based on performance and business needs

- $6 per hour starting rate (over time there is the possibility of higher pay when delivering high-performing ads)

- Long-term collaboration

- Consistent video editing work

- Clear creative briefs, examples and structured workflows

- Access to advanced creative and AI tools

- Ongoing product launches and opportunities to work on different products

- Opportunities to develop your editing skills and creative understanding

- A fast-moving, performance-driven team



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, not just complete a few one-off projects.



As we expand into more markets and increase our creative testing volume, there will be opportunities to take on more hours and responsibilities.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with video editing

3. Examples of video ads you have personally edited (portfolio or links)

4. Your experience with B-roll, voiceovers, UGC and other video formats

5. The video editing software you normally use

6. Any experience you have with eCommerce or Meta ads

7. Your availability and how many hours per week you can work



Please make sure to include examples of your previous video editing work. Applications without video examples will not be considered.



Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Leasing Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
Real Estate Property Management | Full-Time | Remote



Who We Are



We are a growing U.S. real estate investment and property management company looking for an outstanding Guest Card Coordinator to join our team.



We manage rental properties and receive inquiries every day from people interested in renting our apartments and houses. We need someone who can turn those inquiries into real conversations, scheduled showings, and rental applications.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply copies and pastes responses. We want someone who knows how to communicate with people, build interest, and get results.



What You Will Do



Monitor and manage incoming guest cards and leasing leads in AppFolio.



Respond to rental inquiries quickly through text,
, and other communication channels.



Follow up with prospects who don't respond to the first message.



Keep conversations going naturally and encourage prospects to take the next step.



Help prospects understand the property's features, availability, pricing, and rental process.



Answer questions, address concerns, and help overcome common objections.



Convert inquiries into scheduled property tours and rental applications.



Maintain accurate notes and update prospect records in AppFolio.



Follow up consistently with interested prospects until they rent, decline, or are no longer viable leads.



Track results, identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, and suggest better ways to communicate with prospects.



The Most Important Requirement: Excellent Communication Skills



We need someone whose written English sounds natural, friendly, casual, and confident.



Our prospects should feel like they are talking to a real person who wants to help them find a home—not a scripted customer service representative.



You should be comfortable using conversational language, asking engaging questions, and adapting your tone to the person you're talking to.



For example, we don't want a response like:



"Dear Prospective Tenant, thank you for your inquiry regarding our available rental property. Please advise if you would like additional information."



We want someone who can communicate more naturally, such as:



"Hey John! Yep, this one's still available. Are you looking to move pretty soon, or just starting to check out your options? I can help you figure out if this place might be a good fit!"



You must know how to get people talking, build rapport, and move a conversation forward without being pushy.



If your communication style is overly formal, rigid, or dependent on canned scripts, this position probably isn't for you.



Who We Are Looking For



Excellent written and spoken English.



A friendly, outgoing personality and natural conversational style.



Strong sales instincts and the ability to influence people through communication.



Experience in sales, appointment setting, leasing, lead generation, or customer engagement.



Persistence and consistency with follow-up.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.



Comfortable learning software and managing multiple leads simultaneously.



Reliable internet connection and a professional work environment.



Willingness to work U.S. business hours as required.



Experience with AppFolio, property management, or U.S. residential leasing is a plus, but we are willing to train the right person.



How We Measure Success



Your success will be measured by results, including:



Speed of response to new inquiries.



Percentage of prospects who respond to our messages.



Number of meaningful conversations started.



Tours scheduled and applications generated.



Consistency and quality of follow-up.



Accuracy of AppFolio records.



We care about results, not just how many messages you send.



What We Offer



Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. real estate company.



Clear expectations and performance goals.



Training on our properties, processes, and systems.



Opportunity to grow with the company as you demonstrate your abilities.



A team environment where initiative, ideas, and ownership are valued.



Compensation will depend on experience, communication skills, and demonstrated ability.



How to Apply



We want to see how you actually communicate, so please follow these instructions carefully.



1. Tell us about yourself. Briefly describe your experience in sales, leasing, appointment setting, or customer communication.



2. Answer this scenario:



A prospect submits an inquiry about one of our two-bedroom apartments. You respond that the apartment is available, but they never reply.



Write the text message you would send to get the conversation started again.



Don't give us a generic template. Write what you would genuinely send to a real person.



3. Tell us about your sales experience. Give us an example of how you convinced an unresponsive or hesitant prospect to take the next step.



4. Include a short voice recording or video introduction so we can hear how you communicate in English.



We are looking for someone who is personable, confident, proactive, and naturally good with people.



If you know how to turn an inquiry into a conversation and a conversation into action, we want to hear from you!

title: Cleaning Company VA: VOICE CLIP REQUIRED. Paid Training Month, Then a Big Raise (US Maid Service Experience)
description:
HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern.



PAY: The first month is a paid training month at $500. That month is how we see the quality of your work: how fast you reply, how you sound on calls, how you handle clients and cleaners. If it's working, you get a substantial raise after the first month, to $1,000+/month for the right person, and it keeps going up as we grow. Paid monthly through OnlineJobs.ph Easypay. Long-term, full-time, working directly with the two owners. No middle managers.



We're doing it this way because we'd rather pay a great person well than pay an okay person a little. If you're good at this, the training month is the easiest $500 you'll make and the raise is real.



NO VOICE CLIP = NO APPLICATION. READ THIS FIRST.

Every application MUST start with a link to a 60-90 second voice clip of you talking. We hire from the voice clip. We don't read anything else until we've heard it.

- Easiest way: go to 
, press the red button, talk, press stop, then copy the link it gives you.

- Put the link on the VERY FIRST LINE of your message, before "Hi".

- The link must play without a login. Google Drive is fine if it's set to "Anyone with the link".

- No voice clip, a broken link, a link we have to request access to, or an AI / text-to-speech voice = deleted without reading. No exceptions, even if your experience is perfect.

- A resume, portfolio or intro video about yourself is NOT the voice clip. We want the sales call described in step 1 at the bottom.



TWO MORE THINGS ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE.



1. You've already done this exact job for a US house cleaning company. You've worked as a VA, booker or dispatcher for a US maid service: recurring cleans, deep cleans, move-outs. Window cleaning, pressure washing, janitorial-only or Airbnb turnovers don't count. If you haven't worked for a US house cleaning company, please don't apply. We'll skip it, even if you're great at everything else.



2. You sound like you were born and raised in the United States. This is the one part we can't bend on. We're listening for one thing: would a customer in Miami who calls us assume they're talking to someone from the US? If there's any accent at all, even a light one, we won't be able to pick you. No hard feelings, and it's nothing against you or your English. If people often ask whether you grew up in the States, this job is for you.



Spanish is a big plus. A lot of our clients speak Spanish, so if you can take a call in Spanish too, tell us and show us in your voice clip.



ABOUT US

We're Mark and Joey, two 19-year-old college students running Vassal Cleaning, a house cleaning company in Miami and South Florida. We book cleans for nice homes and send independent cleaners to do them. Small team, no corporate stuff, and you'd be the voice of the company. We want someone who feels like a friend on the team: chill, funny, and locks in when it counts. If you're super formal and stiff, this probably isn't for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Booking and sales (most of the job)

- Text every new lead back in under a minute, then call them. Leads come from Thumbtack, Google and our website.

- Quote from our price list (standard, deep, move-in/move-out, add-ons like inside the fridge and oven) and close the booking in our system.

- Handle "that's more than I expected," and follow up with everyone who didn't book.



Dispatch

- Match each booked clean with a cleaner in that area, and confirm both the day before and the day of.

- When a cleaner cancels at 7 AM for a 9 AM job, find a replacement fast and tell the client before they notice.



Customer service

- Reschedules, add-ons and complaints. A missed spot means booking a reclean, not arguing.

- Keep every client's notes right: gate codes, parking, pets, what they care about.



MUST HAVE

- A 60-90 second voice clip on the first line of your application (see the top). We d
 from it alone, and we're listening for an American-sounding voice.

- 1+ year booking or dispatching for a US house cleaning company. Name the company, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week.

- You've quoted cleans by bedrooms/bathrooms or square feet, and you know a standard from a deep from a move-out clean.

- At your computer the whole shift, replying in under a minute. Reliable internet plus a backup, a quiet room and a good headset.



BIG PLUS

- Spanish, well enough to take a booking call

- Cleaning software: Booking Koala, ZenMaid, Launch27, Jobber, Housecall Pro, MaidCentral

- Quo/OpenPhone, Thumbtack, Angi, Yelp or Google Local Services

- You know Miami and keep up with US pop culture



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application ourselves. If it reads like ChatGPT wrote it, we skip it. Write like you'd text a friend; typos are fine. Skip a step and we won't read the rest.



1. FIRST LINE: your voice clip link (
 is easiest). 60-90 seconds. Talk like it's a real call: a lead asks "How much for a deep clean, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, about 1,800 sq ft?" Give a price (make one up). They say "hmm, that's more than I expected." Show us what you say next. If you speak Spanish, do 20 seconds of it in Spanish at the end. Test the link in a private browser window before you send it.

2. Subject line: "Voice Clip - [your name] - [the US cleaning company you worked for]"

3. Your house cleaning experience in 3-4 sentences: the company, the city it served, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week, and what software you used.

4. Two quick texts, 1-2 sentences each:

   a. A client texts that the cleaner missed the baseboards and the shower glass. What do you text back?

   b. A cleaner texts at 7 AM that she can't make her 9 AM job. What do you do first?

5. Three quick ones, one line each. No Googling. Wrong answers are fine, we just want your gut answer.

   a. Who is TJR?

   b. A client says "I'm in the 305." What does that mean?

   c. On a Sunday in October a client says "Can the cleaner come after the Dolphins game?" Roughly what time do you book it for?

6. Confirm you're good with the paid training month ($500), and that you can work 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday.



Reminder: no voice clip link on the first line = we don't read it.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test call with us.

title: SALES SUPPORT
description:
# GMDC Inc. – AVIATION DIVISION



## AVIATION SALES SUPPORT & RFQ RESEARCH SPECIALIST



**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Engagement:** Independent Contractor  

**Workload:** Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity  

**Compensation:** Based on Experience and Qualifications



### ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



GMDC Inc., a US-based aviation parts trading company, is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented and commercially minded professional based in the Philippines to provide remote aviation sales support and RFQ research services.



The primary responsibility is to **screen and evaluate incoming aircraft parts and tooling Requests for Quotation (RFQs)** received through GMDC's subscribed aviation trading platforms, identify genuine business opportunities, and forward only those enquiries that warrant further attention to our Sales team.



All incoming RFQs from these platforms will be routed to the successful candidate for initial assessment.



The objective is to help our Sales team focus its time and resources on credible, commercially worthwhile opportunities rather than responding indiscriminately to every enquiry.



This is an aviation research, customer qualification and sales-operations support position. **It is not a cold-calling, commission-based sales or direct selling role.**



The successful candidate should possess a good understanding of the aviation aftermarket, strong investigative skills and the commercial judgement to distinguish credible purchasing opportunities from speculative, repetitive or low-value enquiries.



### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



**1. RFQ Screening and Opportunity Qualification**



- Review incoming RFQs received through GMDC's subscribed aviation trading platforms, including ILSmart, PartsBase and StockMarket.

- Conduct an initial assessment of each RFQ to determine whether it represents a credible and potentially worthwhile sales opportunity.

- Research the requesting company to establish its business activities, market position, credibility and likely purchasing requirements.

- Distinguish between airlines, aircraft operators, MROs, aircraft parts distributors, brokers and other aviation-related businesses.

- Assess the relevance of the requested aircraft parts or tooling, the customer's business activities, apparent purchasing potential and any previous dealings with GMDC.

- Identify speculative, repetitive, questionable or otherwise low-priority enquiries that do not justify further Sales attention.

- **Forward only qualified RFQs with commercial merit to GMDC's Sales team**, accompanied by a concise explanation of why the opportunity should be pursued.

- Ensure that potentially valuable enquiries are not overlooked, while minimising unnecessary referrals.



**2. Company Research and Due Diligence**



- Investigate unfamiliar companies using aviation industry databases, company websites, public business records and other reliable research sources.

- Verify company identities, business activities and relevant aviation industry credentials where possible.

- Determine whether an RFQ sender is likely to be an actual end user, an established intermediary or a speculative broker.

- Identify inconsistencies, questionable information or potential commercial risks.

- Use approved AI-assisted research tools where helpful, while independently verifying important findings rather than relying solely on AI-generated information.



**3. Systems, Records and Reporting**



- Use GMDC's Quantum system to review relevant customer information, previous activity and RFQ history.

- Maintain accurate customer and opportunity records, including concise supporting research notes.

- Document RFQ assessments and qualification decisions in an organised and consistent manner.

- Prepare clear, actionable summaries for the Sales team, identifying the customer, relevant findings, reason for referral and any matters requiring further verification.

- Track outstanding research items and provide periodic updates on RFQ screening activity.

- Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with GMDC's data-handling and information-security procedures.



**4. Additional Sales Support**



- Undertake related aviation market research, company investigations and sales-operations support within the agreed scope.

- Assist in identifying potentially valuable customer relationships and business opportunities arising from incoming RFQs.

- Support the Sales team with additional background research when requested.



### REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Previous experience in aviation or aerospace parts trading, airline materials departments, MRO operations, aircraft component distribution or a closely related industry.

- Good understanding of the commercial aviation aftermarket and the different roles of aircraft operators, MROs, distributors and brokers.

- Strong online research and analytical skills, including the ability to verify information from multiple sources.

- Sound commercial judgement and the ability to distinguish promising sales opportunities from enquiries unlikely to result in business.

- Excellent written English, particularly the ability to communicate findings clearly, accurately and concisely.

- Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to work independently while managing multiple enquiries.

- Reliable computer equipment, secure internet connectivity and consistent communication availability.



### PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following would be advantageous:



- ILSmart, PartsBase, StockMarket or similar aviation trading platforms.

- Quantum Control or other aviation ERP, inventory management or CRM systems.

- Aircraft part-number research and aviation inventory terminology.

- Customer qualification, company due diligence and aviation market research.

- Microsoft Excel and responsible use of AI-assisted research tools.



**Previous experience with every platform is not required.** GMDC will provide initial training to familiarise the successful candidate with its subscribed platforms, RFQ screening procedures and Quantum system.



### TRAINING AND INITIAL SUPPORT



GMDC will provide initial guidance and practical training covering:



- Accessing and reviewing RFQs through the company's subscribed aviation platforms.

- Understanding GMDC's criteria for evaluating and prioritising incoming enquiries.

- Researching prospective customers and documenting findings.

- Using Quantum to review customer information and maintain relevant records.

- Preparing qualified RFQ referrals and supporting summaries for the Sales team.



The successful candidate will be expected to develop increasing independence, accuracy and efficiency as they become familiar with GMDC's systems and procedures.



### ENGAGEMENT ARRANGEMENTS



- **Location:** Remote – Philippines.

- **Engagement:** Independent contractor under a mutually agreed services agreement.

- **Workload:** Full-time service capacity, approximately 40 hours per week, with an agreed schedule and reasonable overlap with US Eastern Time for communication and coordination.

- **Duration:** Intended as a long-term engagement, subject to satisfactory performance and mutually agreed terms.

- **Compensation:** To be agreed based on qualifications, relevant experience and the candidate's proposed monthly remuneration.

- **Equipment:** The contractor is expected to provide their own computer and reliable internet connection.



Performance will be assessed primarily on the accuracy, consistency and timeliness of RFQ screening, the quality of qualified opportunities referred to Sales, and the reliability of supporting research.



The contractor will not be authorised to issue commercial quotations, negotiate pricing, commit inventory or agree contractual terms on behalf of GMDC unless specifically authorised.



### HOW TO APPLY



Interested candidates should apply through **OnlineJobs.ph** or
 
 marked:



**Attention: President – Aviation Sales Support Application**



Please include the following information:



1. A brief summary of your relevant aviation or aerospace industry experience.

2. Details of any aviation trading platforms, inventory systems or ERP software you have previously used.

3. Your **expected monthly remuneration in USD** for a full-time remote contractor engagement.

4. Your earliest available start date and availability for coordination with a US Eastern Time-based team.

5. A short explanation of how you would investigate an unfamiliar company submitting an aircraft-parts RFQ and determine whether the enquiry should be referred to a Sales team.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a **short, paid, job-related research and RFQ qualification exercise**.



---



**GMDC Inc. – Aviation Division**

title: Live Medical Scribe / Patient Triage

The successful candidate must be detail-oriented, adaptable, and capable of supporting healthcare providers while maintaining accurate clinical documentation and providing appropriate assistance to patients.



Key Responsibilities

-Accurately document patient histories, symptoms, examination findings, assessments, diagnoses, and treatment plans as directed by the provider.

-Enter clinical notes into the electronic health record (EHR) system in real time.

-Maintain accurate, complete, and organized medical records.

-Understand medical terminology, clinical abbreviations, and common healthcare procedures.

-Review documentation for accuracy and completeness, following established clinic protocols.

-Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.



2. Patient Triage and Call Handling

-Handle incoming patient triage calls as assigned.

-Gather relevant information about patient symptoms, concerns, and medical history.

-Document patient calls accurately and route concerns to the appropriate healthcare provider.

-Follow established triage protocols and escalation procedures.

-Recognize potentially urgent symptoms and promptly escalate them to the appropriate clinical personnel.

-Communicate professionally and empathetically with patients.

-Avoid providing independent diagnoses or medical advice beyond authorized protocols and professional scope.



Administrative Support:

-Assist with administrative and documentation tasks during downtime.

-Update patient records and maintain organized documentation.

-Support general clinic operations as assigned.

-Coordinate with healthcare providers and team members to ensure efficient workflows.

-Adapt to changing priorities and scheduling requirements.



Qualifications and Requirements:

-Nursing background is required.

-Hands-on live medical scribing experience is mandatory. Candidates without actual live medical scribing experience will not be considered.

-Experience handling patient triage calls is strongly preferred.

-Strong clinical knowledge and familiarity with medical terminology.

-Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

-Strong documentation, listening, and information-gathering skills.

-Fast, accurate, organized, and highly efficient.

-Ability to multitask and remain focused in a fast-paced clinical environment.

-Professional, reliable, and detail-oriented.

-Willingness to assist with administrative tasks when needed.

-Amenable to rotating morning and evening shifts.

-Available to start as soon as possible.



Work Schedule:

The schedule will be discussed during the interview. Candidates must be flexible and willing to work rotating morning and evening shifts based on clinic operations and staffing requirements.



What We’re Looking For:

We are looking for someone who can confidently support healthcare providers in real time, document clinical encounters accurately, and communicate effectively with patients. The ideal candidate combines nursing knowledge with practical live medical scribing experience and understands the importance of accuracy, confidentiality, professionalism, and timely escalation of patient concerns.

title: Experienced Wedding Video Editor
description:
Rock Penguin Media is looking for a skilled and reliable wedding video editor to join our team long-term.



This is **NOT a beginner position.**



We are looking for an editor who understands cinematic wedding storytelling, pacing, music, audio, color grading, and how to create an emotional film that keeps the viewer engaged from beginning to end.



You must be comfortable creating 6–12 minute wedding highlight films without losing the story, pacing, or viewer's attention.



We do not create re-caps. We create stories of people's day.



The Position



This is a remote, long-term role with consistent work for the right editor who communicates well.



Most projects will be weddings, but projects may also include engagement and proposals.



Each standard project will typically include:



* 1 trailer

* 1 highlight film

* 3 social media reels

* Add ons - ceremony edit, 4 desired clips, reception edits (often, but not every wedding)



Highlight Wedding films will generally range from 6–12 minutes, depending on the wedding and project.



Some projects may also include:



* Reception edits

* Speech/toast edits

* Other documentary-style edits



Editing Style & Experience



We want someone who understands how to tell the full story of a wedding day, rather than simply placing pretty clips over music.



Because we work with multiple filmmakers and associates, footage will come from **different shooters, camera systems, shooting styles, and experience levels**.



We are looking for an editor who can recognize the strongest footage available, work creatively around imperfections when necessary, and maintain consistent storytelling, color, pacing, and overall quality across projects.



You should be comfortable with:



* Multi-camera wedding footage

* Footage from multiple shooters and varying experience levels

* Different cameras, picture profiles, and shooting styles

* Syncing external audio

* Using vows and speeches to build a story

* Music selection and pacing

* Natural audio and sound design

* Color correction and grading

* Matching footage between different cameras

* Working creatively around imperfect footage when necessary

* Creating seamless transitions

* Working with drone footage

* Creating both cinematic and documentary edits

* Selecting the strongest footage from a large amount of raw footage

* Creating short-form social media edits from the same wedding

* Maintaining a consistent final product regardless of who filmed the project



**DaVinci Resolve is our preferred editing software.**



Experience editing Arab, Persian, Indian, Pakistani, South Asian, or other multicultural weddings is a major bonus.



If you have this experience, please specifically mention it in your application and provide examples.

**$150 USD per completed project**

Documentary Edit Pay



Projects requiring additional documentary edits will receive an additional **$50 USD per qualifying project** on top of your project compensation.



For example, if  your project includes a qualifying documentary edit, your compensation for that project would be **$200 USD**.



Compensation includes reasonable revisions necessary to complete each standard project.



How to Apply — FOLLOW DIRECTIONS CAREFULLY



Respond with the subject line:



**"I want to work for you Victoria"**



Your application MUST include:



1. Name

2.

3. Phone number / WhatsApp

4. Operating System — Mac and PC are both accepted

5. Editing Software

6. Links to at least 3–5 recent wedding films that YOU personally edited, with 1–2 being films longer than 6 minutes.

7. Tell us whether you have experience editing Arab, Persian, Indian, Pakistani, South Asian, or multicultural weddings.

8. If yes, include at least one example.

title: PERFORMANCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER — STATIC AD
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Static Ad Designer
description:
Static Ad Designer – Health & Beauty E-commerce (Remote, Full-Time)



We’re a growing e-commerce company in the health and beauty space — supplements, creams, oils, and more — running paid ads across Meta in 10 different countries. We’re looking for a talented static ad designer to join our team and create high-converting ad creatives using Canva.



What You’ll Do



You’ll design static ad creatives for our Meta campaigns — from scratch or by iterating on existing concepts. You’ll follow our brand guidelines and creative direction to produce ads that are clean, on-brand, and built to perform. You’ll also be responsible for creating variations across formats and sizes, organizing files, and naming everything according to our conventions. Speed and consistency matter — we move fast and launch new creatives regularly.



Compensation & Schedule



$4 or 5$/hour depending on experience  (~$1,000/month)

~8 hours per day, 6 days per week

Flexible scheduling within your shift

Long-term position with room to grow alongside the team



What We’re Looking For



Strong eye for design — clean layouts, solid typography, and an understanding of what makes an ad stop the scroll

Proficient in Canva (this is our primary design tool)

Experience designing static ads for e-commerce or direct response advertising

Comfortable navigating Google Sheets for creative tracking and reporting

Strong attention to detail — you double-check alignment, copy, and file naming before submitting

Available 6 days a week for a dedicated, full-time commitment (this must be your only role)

Reliable, fast internet connection and a backup plan for power outages

A quiet, focused workspace

Responsive during shift hours and willing to hop on calls when needed

Clear communicator — you ask questions when something is unclear and flag issues early



Bonus (Not Required)



Experience in the health, beauty, or supplement space

Familiarity with direct response or performance marketing creative

Understanding of what makes a Meta ad convert (hooks, contrast, readability)



How to Apply



If you’ve read this entire post, send a message starting with “READY” along with a short Loom video covering the following:



Start by briefly introducing yourself (age, city, marital status).



Then answer these questions:



Availability — What does your life outside of work look like? We need to understand any recurring commitments (family obligations, church, studies, etc.). This is a full-time, dedicated role — no other company work is permitted. You don’t need to go into deep detail, just let us know what takes up your time. For example: “I attend church every Sunday from 8–11am” or “I occasionally need to care for a family member on a specific day.”



Location & Internet — Where exactly in the Philippines do you live, and what is your internet speed? Do you have a backup solution for power outages?



Work History — Walk us through every prior role, remote or otherwise, including duration, responsibilities, and why each one ended. Include everything, even short contracts or roles unrelated to ad design. For example: “I worked as a social media designer from June 2023 to July 2025. My main tasks were creating static posts and ad creatives following brand guidelines. The contract ended because the company restructured.”



Portfolio — Please share 3–5 examples of static ads or visual creatives you’ve designed. Canva-made work is preferred. If you have experience with health, beauty, or supplement brands, highlight those.



Please be honest — we take trust seriously and are building for the long term.



Looking forward to meeting you.



— William
