title: HIRING: Exceptional B2B Telemarketer / Appointment Setter $100 Weekly Base + $1,000 for a Prospect Who Becomes a Client
description:
HIRING: Exceptional B2B Telemarketer / Appointment Setter

$100 Weekly Base + $1,000 for Every Prospect Who Becomes a Client



We’re looking for a confident, persuasive, highly capable telemarketer who knows how to reach decision-makers, handle objections, and turn cold conversations into qualified appointments.



You should be comfortable speaking with business owners, managing partners, and executives—and skilled at earning their attention quickly.



The Opportunity



We work with a data broker based in Chicago that evaluates businesses for paid data partnerships. Qualifying businesses may receive compensation for operational data used to help train advanced AI models, with potential payments reaching six figures or more, subject to the data company’s review.



Your role is to introduce the opportunity, confirm initial qualifications, and schedule a conversation with our data specialist.



Who You’ll Contact



We target businesses with these minimum numbers of office employees who work on computers:



Law firms: 10+ employees.



Accounting firms: 15+ employees.



Medical practices: 15+ employees.



Finance businesses: 15+ employees.



All other industries: 50+ employees, including freight, staffing, manufacturing, and other established businesses.



Prospects should also use at least five business communication or workflow platforms, such as Gmail, Outlook, Google Drive, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, 
, DocuSign, or a CRM.



What You’ll Do



Make outbound calls and navigate gatekeepers professionally.



Connect with owners, managing partners, and other decision-makers.



Confirm employee counts, business history, and software platforms.



Explain the opportunity clearly and accurately.



Handle skepticism confidently and direct detailed data, privacy, and valuation questions to the specialist.



Schedule qualified appointments and follow up consistently.



Maintain accurate notes on conversations and next steps.



Who We Want



A proven B2B cold caller with measurable appointment-setting results.



A clear, engaging communicator who builds trust quickly.



Someone who listens carefully and adapts naturally during conversations.



A persistent, organized professional who follows through.



Someone comfortable discussing a substantial business opportunity with senior decision-makers.



Compensation



Base: $100 per week.



Bonus: $1,000 for every prospect you bring in who becomes a client.



For example, five converted clients earn you $5,000 in bonuses, plus your weekly base.



The bonus is tied to client conversion, rather than appointment booking.



How to Apply



Send Steven Raposo:



A brief summary of your B2B telemarketing experience.



Examples of your results, including appointments booked or clients generated.



A short voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating how you would open a call with a business owner.



 with the title “TELEMARKETER” and your application details.



If you know how to open doors, earn trust, and create qualified opportunities, we want to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist: AI Animation & Drama Ads | Skincare Brand
description:
Creative Strategist: AI Animation & Drama Ads | Skincare Brand

Starting at $2,000/month + 3% of ad spend on your ads



We’re hiring a hands-on creative strategist for Lumié Paris, a direct-to-consumer skincare brand.



You must be an expert in direct-response marketing, AI animation video ads, and story-driven drama ads. Familiarity with AI tools alone is not enough. We need someone who can develop original concepts, write compelling scripts, and turn them into finished ads built to acquire customers.



We will provide specific examples of the creative direction we want.



What you’ll create



Our focus is on two formats:



- AI animation ads: Animated characters, talking products, visual demonstrations, and unexpected concepts that make people stop scrolling.

- Drama ads: Character-led stories with conflict, emotion, suspense, surprises, and a compelling payoff that connects naturally to the product.



We want someone who understands how to make an entertaining story sell. The hook, pacing, product introduction, objection handling, offer, and CTA should all have a purpose.



This role goes beyond basic AI talking-head videos or recycling the same UGC script.



Your responsibilities



- Research customers, competitors, objections, and buying motivations.

- Develop fresh concepts and direct-response angles.

- Write scripts, hooks, scene sequences, and production briefs.

- Produce AI-generated video ads through to finished edits.

- Maintain consistent characters, voices, environments, and product appearance.

- Create meaningful variations and iterate based on performance.

- Explain why an ad worked or failed and what you would test next.



This is a high-output role with substantial ongoing work.** Expect frequent creative production, testing, feedback, and revisions. We’ll agree on weekly deliverables, turnaround times, and availability before starting.



Required experience



- Proven experience creating ads that have received over $100,000 in ad spend.

- A portfolio demonstrating both AI animation and drama/storytelling ads.

- Strong direct-response copywriting and customer psychology expertise.

- Hands-on command of AI video generation, voice, lip-sync, editing, and production workflows.

- Ability to interpret creative performance using metrics such as retention, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS.

- Strong English scriptwriting and natural dialogue.



Skincare, beauty, or comparable DTC experience is highly relevant.



We need evidence of your contribution, not just screenshots of an account you were associated with. Show the creatives, their spend and results, and exactly what you personally handled.



Compensation



ase compensation starts at $2,000 per month, plus 3% of the ad spend on ads you create.



The budget shown on this listing is a starting point, **not a definitive ceiling**. Final compensation will reflect your experience, responsibilities, and agreed workload.



How we’ll start



We will begin with a one-week trial in which you create ads for our brand. Trial scope, compensation, and deliverables will be agreed before it begins.



We’ll evaluate your research, direct-response thinking, originality, execution, communication, and ability to respond to feedback.



Expect questions about your decisions: Why this hook? Why this angle? What objection are you addressing? How does the story lead to the sale? What would you change if retention were strong but conversions were weak?



Your marketing judgment matters as much as your production skills.



References to review before applying



We’ll provide additional animation and drama-ad examples during the selection process.



How to apply



**Start your application with “IAQ” so we know you read the entire post.**



Include:



1. Your portfolio, highlighting AI animation and drama ads.

2. The brands you’ve worked with and your exact responsibilities.

3. Evidence of the $100,000+ ad-spend requirement, including spend per creative, date ranges, and performance results. Redacted evidence is welcome.

4. A brief breakdown of one successful ad: the insight, hook, selling argument, and why you believe it worked.

5. Your AI production tools, weekly capacity, availability, and compensation expectations.



Please apply only if you can demonstrate both strong creative execution and proven direct-response expertise.



Required AI production experience



Hands-on experience with Higgsfield, Seedance 2.5, and Kie.ai is required.



You must show finished AI animation and drama ads you personally worked on, explain your production workflow, and identify exactly what you created.



Knowing the tools is not enough. You must also meet our direct-response, portfolio, and $100,000+ creative ad-spend requirements. We are hiring someone who can develop the strategy and execute it, not someone learning the tools on our budget.

title: Tech & Customer Experience Lead
description:
About us

Know Thyself is a podcast hosted by André Duqum, with a paid membership community called the Know Thyself Collective. We run live workshops with guest teachers, a weekly newsletter, and a growing set of digital products. We’re looking for someone who can own the technical side so our team can focus on content and community.



What you’ll do



Landing pages



Build and update landing pages for workshops, lead magnets, and product launches (Squarespace, plus custom pages on Netlify).

Keep pages current: new guest pages, banner swaps, past sessions, checkout links.



Tech integrations



Connect and maintain our stack: Circle, Stripe, Klaviyo, Zapier, Google Analytics 4, ManyChat, and Shopify.

Set up automations like trial enrollment, welcome flows, and RSVP tracking, and keep conversion tracking clean.

Troubleshoot when something breaks, and document how it all works.



Customer experience



Make buying, logging in, and getting started as smooth as possible for members and customers.

Improve onboarding
s, login instructions, cancellation flows, and order communications.

Spot friction points from support requests and refunds, and fix the cause.



Your first project: launching our journal on Shopify Collective

We’re launching the Know Thyself x Open Journal through Shopify Collective, with our fulfillment partner (WHP) handling production and shipping. You’ll own the setup from start to launch:

title: OTE $1,500 - $4,000 DM Appointment Setter, US Real Estate Investing (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
We are Deal Engine, a US real estate investing company. We help investors buy, remodel, and refinance rental properties remotely, and we teach investors how to do it themselves. Our content runs on YouTube and Instagram, and prospects message us directly from that content. Your job is to turn those DM conversations into booked sales calls.



This is a full-time remote role working US business hours. You will be responding to inbound Instagram DMs from people who have just watched our content and reached out. You are not spamming strangers. These are warm leads who messaged first.



What you will actually do: reply to every inbound DM fast, ideally within 15 minutes. Hold real conversations, not one-liner scripts. Ask qualifying questions to understand their situation: what they want to achieve, their timeline, and their budget range. Match the length and tone of the message they sent you. When someone is qualified, send them a booking link for a call with our team. Log every conversation in our CRM. Follow up with people who went quiet until they book or tell you to stop.



What we are looking for: excellent written English that reads like a natural texter, not translated text. Real sales, customer service, or appointment setting experience, ideally over chat or DM. Comfortable following a script while still sounding human. Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and availability during US hours. Experience with CRMs or social media inboxes is a plus but we will train the right person.



Compensation: $500 plus a per-booking performance bonus, paid monthly. Top setters here earn significantly more than base through bonuses. Last month our top setter made $4,000



To apply, do two things. First, include the word orange somewhere in your application so we know you read this far. Applications without it are deleted, no exceptions. Second, complete the sample task below.



Sample task. A prospect replies to our Instagram story with this message: "hey saw your post about the oklahoma deals, im interested but i only have like 20k saved and i still work full time, is that even enough to start?" Write your reply exactly as you would send it in the DM. Do not write what you would do next, write the actual message.



We grade that sample on three things: does it sound like a real person, does it ask one clear question that moves the conversation forward, and does it match the length and energy of what the prospect sent. If your reply is a wall of text or a copy-paste script, you will not move forward.

title: YouTube Long-Form Video Rough Cut Editor
description:

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
We’re a London-based creative and social media studio working with premium fashion, beauty, wellness and lifestyle brands, alongside younger consumer and Gen Z-focused businesses.



We’re looking for a Social Media Assistant to help us manage the day-to-day presence of multiple client accounts.



The biggest part of this role will be community engagement and publishing - keeping accounts active, visible and socially relevant through thoughtful comments, Story interaction, posting and day-to-day account management.



You’ll be working across brands with very different personalities, so being able to recognise and adapt to different tones of voice is essential. A comment that works for a playful Gen Z brand will not work for a premium skincare or luxury fashion client.



We’re looking for someone who genuinely understands social media culture rather than someone who simply knows how to schedule posts.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 



* Manage day-to-day community engagement across Instagram and other relevant platforms

* Proactively engage with relevant accounts, creators, customers and communities through thoughtful, brand-appropriate comments

* Maintain visibility through Instagram Stories, including viewing, reacting and engaging where relevant

* Monitor comments, tags, mentions and DMs, responding where appropriate and flagging anything that needs attention from the wider team

* Schedule and publish approved content across multiple client accounts

* Keep content calendars accurate and ensure everything is posted correctly and on time

* Write and adapt short-form social copy across Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn within established brand tones

* Stay socially aware of trends, conversations, memes, platform language and shifts in online culture

* Flag relevant trends and opportunities without forcing them onto brands where they don’t belong

* Create simple Instagram Story assets and social graphics using existing Canva templates

* Make simple edits to short-form video content, including trimming, subtitles and formatting

* Support monthly reporting and flag noticeable changes in account performance

* Keep client assets, calendars and internal documentation organised



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



* 1+ year of experience in social media, community management or a similar role

* Very strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok culture

* Strong written English

* Confidence adapting your writing and commenting style between completely different brands

* Good judgment around tone - knowing when a funny or casual comment works and when a brand should stay more considered and refined

* Comfortable proactively commenting and interacting rather than waiting for engagement to come to the account

* Basic Canva skills

* Basic short-form video editing skills

* Strong attention to detail - especially when switching between different client accounts

* Highly organised and comfortable following established processes





YOU'LL PROBABLY BE A GOOD FIT IF... 



- You notice when a brand’s comment section feels forced.

- You understand that “social media engagement” doesn’t mean leaving generic comments like Love this! under 50 posts.

- You know the difference between how a Gen Z wellness brand might speak online and how a premium fashion or skincare brand should behave.

- You follow trends, creators and online conversations naturally, but you also know that not every trend belongs on every account.

- And you’re comfortable learning the personality of each brand well enough that your engagement feels like it genuinely came from them.





WORKING SETUP



This is a remote role with a flexible schedule, but we require daily overlap between 10AM-3PM GMT for team communication, approvals and collaboration. You’ll work closely with our small team and follow established strategies, brand guidelines and engagement directions for each client.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

* A short cover letter explaining why you think you’d be a good fit

* Your CV

* A portfolio or examples of social media accounts/content you’ve worked on

* Links to any Instagram or TikTok accounts you have previously managed or supported

title: Part-Time Patient Lead Caller / Intake Coordinator (US Clinic, Night Shift PH)
description:
Job description



When someone asks us about treatment, the first phone call they get from us sets the tone. We want that call to come from you, fast and kind.



Vita Nova Ketamine & Wellness Clinic is a US clinic in Maryland. We offer ketamine infusions, IV iron and IV therapy, with anesthesiologist-led care under Dr. Joshi's medical direction, with infusions given by a nurse practitioner or CRNA.



Most of our new inquiries come from
 and Instagram lead forms and land in our CRM, GoHighLevel. We are looking for a part-time Patient Lead Caller to reach each new lead quickly, answer basic questions about how our process works, and book a consultation.



What you will do

- Call every new lead in GoHighLevel as soon as it comes in during your shift, then follow up on a set schedule with people you have not reached yet.

- Send follow-up texts from GoHighLevel using approved templates. Texts only between 9 AM and 8 PM US Eastern, every day.

- Explain our process, hours and next steps, then book consultations in the GoHighLevel calendar.

- Pass every clinical question (symptoms, medications, whether a treatment is right for someone) to our clinicians. You do not give medical advice and you do not promise results.

- Keep clear notes and pipeline stages in GoHighLevel after every call and text.

- Protect patient privacy at all times. You will handle protected health information under HIPAA.



Schedule (night shift in the Philippines)

- 36 hours a week, part time. Weekends are the core shift.

- Saturday and Sunday, 10 AM to 6 PM US Eastern. In the Philippines that is 11 PM to 7 AM on weekend nights (Saturday night into Sunday morning, and Sunday night into Monday morning).

- Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 1 PM US Eastern. In the Philippines that is 10 PM to 2 AM on weeknights (Monday to Friday nights).



Must have

- Experience calling or scheduling US patients, for example at a clinic front desk, in patient scheduling, as a medical virtual assistant, or in med spa or wellness intake.

- Strong spoken and written US English, with a calm and warm phone manner.

- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM.

- Reliable availability on Saturday and Sunday, 10 AM to 6 PM ET, plus weekday mornings, 9 AM to 1 PM ET.

- A quiet, private workspace, a good headset, and stable internet with a backup connection.



Nice to have

- Experience with mental health or infusion clinic patients.

- Experience with HIPAA-compliant workflows and text follow-up.



Before you get access

- You will sign a confidentiality and business associate agreement.

- You will complete HIPAA training before you get any system access.



Pay: an hourly base plus a monthly KPI bonus of up to $150 for speed, quality and follow-through. We discuss the details with finalists.



How to apply

Put the words "Patient First" at the top of your application so we know you read this far. Then send us:

1. A short note about your US patient-facing calling experience (what kind of clinic, how many calls a day, which CRM).

2. A 60 to 90 second voice recording that answers this. A caller asks, "Will ketamine get rid of my depression for good?" Show us how you would respond.

3. A written answer to this. A caller asks, "How much does it cost, and does my insurance cover it?" How would you handle it?

4. Whether you can reliably work Saturday and Sunday, 10 AM to 6 PM ET, plus weekday mornings, 9 AM to 1 PM ET. If any part is a problem, tell us which.



Vita Nova is an equal opportunity organization. We consider all qualified applicants on job-related criteria only.

title: AI Omni / Seedance Video Editors Only

PH DAYTIME HOURS ONLY

THE JOB

- 4 videos a day: 2 up to 1:20 and 2 up to 2:40. Monday to Saturday, some Sundays if needed.

- Fast WhatsApp replies, same day revisions.

- Need a weekday for errands? Swap it for a Sunday, up to once a week. Tell me ahead.

- 100% full time once hired. No other job, not in school.

- No moving your hours to nights later.



If you’re not confident you can finish 4 videos a day within 12 hours, you’re not fast enough for this job. DON’T APPLY. If you can’t meet all of this, DON’T APPLY.



MUST HAVE

- Also: Nano Banana Pro, Veo 3.1, CapCut, and an AI assistant for prompts (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or similar).



PAY

$550 USD every 4 weeks for 96 accepted videos, paid every two weeks via Wise. Miss the quota and your pay is prorated (about $5.73 per accepted video). I pay for your AI tools.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word DETAIL.

In your message:

6. How many finished videos a day you deliver now. Be honest.

7. Your current work hours (PH time) and when you can start.

8. Your WhatsApp number.

9. Confirm: not in school, 10 AM PH start Monday to Saturday, and no other job once hired.



Miss anything, no reply.



NEXT

If I like your work, I’ll set up a call on WhatsApp. If you’re not comfortable with a call, DON’T APPLY.

If hired, your first week is a paid trial. 2 seats.

title: Short-Form Content Strategist & Social Media Manager
description:
NOTE: This position will be a base salary plus bonus structure as we see success on these channels.



About Dude Life



Dude Life is an outdoor entertainment brand focused on adventure, camping, survival, challenges, humor, and inspiring people to get outside and make memories.



We're looking for a highly motivated, creative, and data-driven Social Media Manager to take ownership of our short-form content strategy and help us aggressively grow our presence across TikTok,
, Instagram, Snapchat, and YouTube Shorts.



This isn't a position where you'll simply schedule posts or manage a content calendar.



We want someone who lives and breathes viral content.



Someone who understands why videos get millions of views, can recognize trends before they peak, and knows how to turn great ideas and raw footage into content people actually want to watch and share.



What You'll Be Responsible For



. Viral Content Research & Idea Generation



- Research viral videos, trends, challenges, and content formats across social media platforms.

- Identify successful content ideas we can adapt to the Dude Life brand.

- Study what competing creators and entertainment channels are doing successfully.

- Analyze hooks, storytelling techniques, pacing, and video structures that drive views.

- Consistently pitch fresh, creative, and engaging video ideas.

- Maintain an organized pipeline of content ideas for our filming team.



2. Scriptwriting & Content Planning



- Write engaging scripts and video outlines for short-form content.

- Develop compelling hooks that capture attention immediately.

- Create simple, actionable filming instructions for our team.

- Adapt viral concepts to fit our personalities, audience, and brand.

- Plan challenges, experiments, outdoor activities, and entertaining video concepts.

- Work with our team to coordinate upcoming filming needs.



3. Short-Form Video Editing



- Edit entertaining, high-quality short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, Snapchat, and YouTube Shorts.

- Turn our existing long-form YouTube videos into engaging standalone short-form content.

- Identify funny moments, exciting highlights, and compelling clips within hours of footage.

- Add captions, music, sound effects, graphics, and transitions when appropriate.

- Optimize pacing, storytelling, and hooks to maximize viewer retention.

- Create platform-specific versions of content when necessary.



4. Social Media Growth & Management



- Take ownership of growing our TikTok,
, Instagram, Snapchat, and YouTube Shorts accounts.

- Develop and execute a consistent posting strategy across all platforms.

- Manage the content calendar, scheduling, and publishing.

- Optimize video titles, captions, descriptions, hashtags, and thumbnails where applicable.

- Monitor audience engagement, trends, and content performance.

- Identify opportunities to improve reach, engagement, and follower growth.



5. Analytics & Performance Optimization



- Track views, watch time, retention, engagement, shares, and follower growth.

- Analyze which content formats consistently outperform others.

- Identify why certain videos succeed or fail.

- Test different hooks, editing styles, and content concepts.

- Use performance data to improve future content.

- Provide regular reports on channel growth, top-performing videos, and opportunities.



Who We're Looking For



**You MUST:**



- Have proven experience growing social media accounts through organic short-form content.

- Understand what makes content go viral across multiple platforms.

- Have strong video editing skills.

- Be able to turn long-form videos into entertaining short-form clips.

- Have excellent creative instincts and storytelling abilities.

- Be comfortable researching and developing original content ideas.

- Know how to write engaging hooks and scripts.

- Understand social media analytics and audience retention.

- Be highly organized and capable of managing multiple platforms.

- Be proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable taking ownership of results.



Bonus Points If You:



- Have helped grow an account to 100K+ followers.

- Have created videos that received 1M+ organic views.

- Have experience working with YouTubers or creator-led brands.

- Have experience in outdoor, adventure, challenge, or comedy content.

- Understand the differences between
, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and YouTube Shorts algorithms and audiences.

- Can identify emerging viral trends and adapt them quickly.



How We Measure Success



This role is about **growth and results**, not just posting content.



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



- Growth in total monthly organic views across our platforms.

- Follower and subscriber growth.

- Average views per video.

- Audience retention, watch time, and engagement.

- Consistency and quality of content production.

- Number of successful content ideas developed and executed.

- Ability to continuously improve content performance.



What Makes This Opportunity Different



You'll have access to an established YouTube brand, a large library of existing long-form footage, and a team that regularly films new adventures, challenges, and entertaining content.

title: Marketing Manager: Creative and Paid Social Operations
description:
I’m looking for a hands-on, organized marketer to help grow two consumer brands. We’ll start with one brand and add the second as we build a consistent workflow.



I’ve been in direct-to-consumer marketing for 20 years and will continue to lead strategy, offers, and overall direction. We also have a full-time graphic artist. I need someone who can coordinate our creators, work with AI and our internal graphics team, and keep marketing execution moving without constant reminders.



Your main responsibility will be making sure we have fresh creative ready to test every week, creators stay on schedule, and campaigns get checked consistently.

What you’ll do

- Coordinate creators: send briefs, track samples, follow up on deadlines, request revisions, and collect finished content.

- Work with AI tools and our internal graphics team to develop static ads and creative variations based on winning hooks and videos.

- Give clear creative briefs and feedback, proof finished ads, and make sure assets are ready to launch.

- Coordinate video edits and variations from existing creator content.

- Keep videos, images, and finished ads organized by product, hook, version, usage rights, and testing status.

- Prepare and launch Meta ads within an approved campaign structure and budget.

- Check campaigns daily for spending, performance, tracking problems, broken links, and inventory issues.

- Pause or adjust ads within written rules. Flag anything outside those rules rather than guessing.

- Use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools to help analyze campaign data, then verify the numbers and recommendations.

- Come to a weekly meeting with a clear update: what launched, what worked, what needs attention, and what we should test next.

- Help identify strong creators and build a reliable creator network over time.

- As the core workflow becomes consistent, help support Klaviyo
 campaigns using existing creative and brand direction.

What I’m looking for

- Practical experience using Meta Ads Manager, including setting up ads and reviewing performance.

- Strong organization and follow-through. You notice missing pieces and move work forward.

- Experience coordinating creators, designers, freelancers, or content production.

- The ability to write clear creative briefs, give useful feedback, and catch errors before ads go live.

- Comfort using AI for creative development and analysis, with the judgment to catch mistakes.

- An understanding of marketing metrics such as CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS.

- Clear written English and the ability to give concise updates.

- Good judgment about what you can handle independently and what needs approval.

Experience with Shopify, Klaviyo, creator platforms, and consumer products is helpful. You do not need to be a graphic designer. You’ll work with our internal graphics team to keep creative production organized and on schedule.

You don’t need to be a senior media buyer or develop the entire marketing strategy yourself. You do need to be comfortable working in the tools, following a clear playbook, making recommendations, and taking ownership of execution.

What success looks like

- New creative is ready to test every week.

- Creators and our internal graphics team have clear briefs and deadlines.

- Revisions and approvals don’t get forgotten.

- Ads are checked consistently, and problems are caught early.

- Assets and campaign results are easy to find.

- Our weekly meeting is about decisions and next steps, not chasing updates.

How to apply

5. Your time zone, availability for 40 hours per week, possible start date, and expected monthly compensation.

title: Online English Phonics Teacher
description:
CurioKids teaches children aged 4 to 12 in Singapore and Malaysia to read and speak English through live, 1-to-1 online lessons. Every child starts with our Phonics Starter, learning to read sound by sound using the UK Letters and Sounds method, then moves on to our CEFR-aligned English course.



We launch on 2 November 2026 and are building our founding team of teachers. You will be trained directly by our Head of Curriculum, an experienced phonics teacher.



THE ROLE



Teach live 25-minute 1-to-1 phonics and English lessons to children aged 4 to 12.



Run free trial lessons, including a friendly introduction, a quick assessment of the child's phonics knowledge and a short summary for parents



Write brief notes after every lesson and help prepare progress updates for parents



Record a short "Meet the Teacher" video for our website, as parents choose their own teacher



Cover lessons for colleagues when needed



Follow our safeguarding rules in every lesson



Join weekly team meetings, training and lesson reviews



WORKING SCHEDULE



We are looking for teachers who are flexible and available to work evening shifts and weekends.



Full-time position, 40 working hours per week over 5 days



Working days will include weekdays and weekends, depending on the agreed schedule



Applicants must be willing to work evening shifts, including hours up to 9pm (Philippine time)



Weekend availability is required, either Saturday, Sunday or both, depending on the team's needs



Two rest days per week, based on the agreed working schedule



Working hours include teaching, lesson preparation, student feedback and team meetings



All working hours follow Philippine time (PHT), which is the same as Singapore and Malaysia.



Please apply only if you are comfortable working evening shifts and weekends.



PAY AND BENEFITS



Up to SGD 600 per month, fixed salary, paid on the 10th of each month for the previous month



13th-month payment in December



Paid training on the CurioKids method before your first lesson



Ready-made lesson materials, so no unpaid planning time



Regular pay reviews and opportunities to progress to Senior Teacher



Independent contractor agreement



REQUIREMENTS



TEFL or TESOL certificate (minimum 120 hours)



At least 1 year of experience teaching children aged 4 to 12, online or in a classroom



Clear, confident spoken English and a warm, patient manner with young children



Must be available to work evening shifts, Saturday AND Sunday



Valid NBI clearance (issued within the last 6 months)



Laptop or desktop, headset with noise-cancelling microphone and HD webcam



Stable internet connection of at least 25 Mbps, plus a backup connection



Quiet, well-lit teaching space with a plain background



NICE TO HAVE



Experience teaching phonics (Letters and Sounds, Jolly Phonics or similar)



Education degree or LET licence



Experience teaching children from Singapore or Malaysia



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



Your CV



Your TEFL or TESOL certificate



A 1-minute video introducing yourself as if you were meeting a 5-year-old student



Start your application with the words "Phonics Teacher" so we know you have read this post.



Please also confirm your availability to work evening shifts and weekends.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview. Before your interview, you will complete a short challenge:



Write a lesson plan showing how you would teach a 25-minute phonics lesson to a 5-year-old. Please include:



The sound you are teaching and what the child should be able to do by the end



A warm-up or review of sounds they already know



How you will introduce the new sound (show us you use pure sounds, for example "sss" not "suh")



A blending activity with simple words



A short game to keep the child engaged



A quick check to see what the child has learned



How long each part will take



Be ready to talk us through your plan in the interview.



Successful applicants will need to pass an NBI clearance check, sign an independent contractor agreement and join our paid training before starting their first lessons.

title: Credit Repair Client Onboarding Specialist | $3/Hour | Remote

NO VIDEO = AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION.



NO CREDIT REPAIR EXPERIENCE = AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION.



About the Position

We need someone who already understands the credit repair industry and can confidently guide new clients through our onboarding process with minimal training.



Your job is to make sure every client gets onboarded correctly, completes all required steps, and feels supported.

title: Tax Accountant

Key Responsibilities

title: Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background
description:
# Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background



**NOTES: Tentative start Nov 24th**



**Remote | Philippines | Full-Time Contractor**



Oliant is looking for a strong **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA** professional in the Philippines to lead a growing remote team supporting construction technology, AI-assisted workflows, data quality, and project delivery.



This is not a basic QA role. We are looking for someone who understands construction drawings, project delivery, technical coordination, and quality standards—and can lead a team with structure, patience, accountability, and strong communication.



The ideal candidate may come from an **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or technical QA** background.



## About the Role



As a **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA**, you will manage a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists working across multiple projects. Your main responsibility is to ensure that the team produces accurate, timely, and high-quality work.



You will review project outputs, guide team members, identify quality issues, improve delivery processes, and act as the first escalation point when something needs clarification or correction.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical construction knowledge with people leadership, quality control, and process improvement.



## What You’ll Do



Your responsibilities will include:



* Lead a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.

* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the team’s deliverables.

* Review work before it reaches the client or senior stakeholders.

* Ensure data accuracy, reporting consistency, and adherence to project standards.

* Help team members interpret construction drawings, 3D models, markups, RFIs, redlines, comments, and other technical documents.

* Support weekly workload planning and help assign team members based on project needs, skill level, and capacity.

* Maintain internal trackers, project status updates, and delivery documentation.

* Provide structured feedback to team members.

* Train junior team members on workflows, drawing interpretation, QA standards, platform usage, and delivery expectations.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

* Escalate blockers, risks, and quality concerns early.

* Coordinate with other remote teams involved in project setup, configuration, mapping, QA, and delivery.

* Participate in client-facing or internal stakeholder meetings when needed.

* Help create a culture of ownership, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.



## What We’re Looking For



You should apply if you have:



* A Bachelor’s degree in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering**, or a related construction / technical field.

* Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings, including architectural plans, sections, MEP layouts, structural drawings, fit-out details, and site-related documentation.

* Experience with BIM, construction coordination, project delivery, technical QA, or quality control.

* Experience reviewing technical work for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to catch mistakes before they become client-facing issues.

* Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

* Experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating other team members.

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

* Confidence working with spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and structured project data.

* Ability to learn new tools, platforms, and workflows quickly.



## Helpful Experience



The following experience is helpful, but not all are required:



* Autodesk Revit

* AutoCAD

* Navisworks / NWD model navigation

* BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud

* Bluebeam

* Procore

* Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel

* Primavera P6 or ASTA Powerproject

* Construction progress tracking

* QA process design

* Data validation

* AI-assisted workflows

* Remote team leadership



## Who You Are



We are looking for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented and quality-driven.

* Calm under pressure.

* Clear and respectful when giving feedback.

* Comfortable holding people accountable without micromanaging.

* Proactive in raising risks, blockers, and process gaps.

* Able to explain complex technical issues in simple terms.

* Fair, patient, and supportive with junior team members.

* Comfortable working with changing priorities.

* Interested in technology, AI, construction data, and modern digital workflows.



## Compensation



* **Starting compensation:** **$950 – $1,100 USD/month**, depending on experience and interview performance.

* **Strong candidates with proven leadership, BIM, construction coordination, or QA management experience may be considered up to:** **$1,200 USD/month**.

* Compensation is reviewed based on performance, reliability, quality of work, leadership, communication, and business needs.



This is a full-time contractor role. Weekend or rest-day work may be required depending on project needs and will be handled separately according to the project schedule and applicable rate structure.



## Role Details



* **Location:** Fully remote, Philippines

* **Type:** Full-time contractor

* **Schedule:** Full-time

* **Seniority:** Lead / Senior Technical QA

* **Reports to:** Delivery / Operations Management

* **Team:** You will help lead a growing team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.



## Why Join Oliant?



Oliant works with international clients and remote teams across multiple regions. We are building specialized teams around AI-assisted QA, technical validation, construction data, digital workflows, and project delivery.



This is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to move beyond individual production work and grow into a leadership role where quality, communication, process improvement, and team development matter.



You will help shape how the team works, how quality is maintained, and how junior technical talent grows.



## How to Apply



Please send your resume and a short introduction that includes:



1. Your background in Architecture, Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or QA.

2. The tools you have used, such as Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, BIM 360, Procore, Bluebeam, Excel, or similar platforms.

3. Your experience reviewing drawings, models, reports, or technical project data.

4. Any experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating team members.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



We are looking for someone who can lead with quality, ownership, and good judgment. If that sounds like you, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: SEO Expert
description:
THIS IS A FULL TIME ROLE.



We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them. 



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

• Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

• Crawlability and indexation

• Site architecture and internal linking

• Canonicalization and rendering issues

• Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

• Work directly within:

• WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

• Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

• PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

• Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

• Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

• Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

• Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

• 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

• Comfortable editing live websites and templates

• Working knowledge of:

• HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

• PHP and Shopify Liquid

• Experience working directly inside:

• WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

• Strong understanding of:

• Google Search Console

• Ahrefs / Semrush

• Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

• Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

• Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

• Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

• Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

• Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

• This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

• Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

• You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

title: Experienced Photoshop Editor
description:
Hiring: Advanced Photoshop Editor



**Company:** Rock Penguin Media  

**Job Type:** Freelance / Project-Based (Long-Term Opportunity)  

**Compensation:** $80–$300 USD per project



## About Us



Rock Penguin Media is a U.S.-based wedding photography and videography company specializing in creative, cinematic, and storytelling-driven imagery.



We are looking for an **experienced Adobe Photoshop editor** who specializes in advanced photo manipulation, fantasy editing, and creative wedding photography.



We want someone with a strong artistic eye who can transform ordinary photographs into visually stunning images while maintaining realistic lighting, shadows, and composition.



## First Project: Halloween Fantasy Photoshoot



**Budget: $300 USD for up to 10 edited images**



Our first project is a Halloween-themed photoshoot requiring advanced fantasy editing inspired by the magical, cinematic atmosphere of Harry Potter. We are expecting full image manipulation ranging around these edits

- Wand glow, magical particles, atmospheric fog, color grading, and subtle lighting effects.

- Replacing the environment, detailed subject masking, integrating magical effects, and matching lighting, shadows, and perspective.

- Complex environments, multiple subjects, magical creatures, spell effects, intricate masking, and realistic light interaction.



***These need to be completed by October 30th



We will provide examples from our previous Halloween photoshoot to demonstrate our creative expectations and editing style.



This project happens one to two times a year, but are wanting to bring on the editor who does this one as our companies editor for our wedding photography needs. 



## Ongoing Projects: Wedding Photography



**Budget: $50 USD for 5–10 edited images per project**



Following the Halloween project, we are looking for an editor to assist with creative wedding photography enhancements.



Projects will primarily involve:



- Go through edited gallery and chose the 5-10 images to add the editorial flare to from the portraits section

- Artistic double-exposure photography.

- Realistic motion blur effects.

- Creative lighting and atmospheric enhancements.

- Cinematic Photoshop effects.



Our goal is to create artistic, editorial-style wedding images that stand out while preserving the authenticity of the original photographs.



## Requirements



- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop.

- Strong portfolio demonstrating photo manipulation and creative compositing.

- Experience with realistic lighting, shadows, masking, and blending.

- Ability to produce fantasy-inspired and cinematic imagery.

- Experience with wedding or portrait photography preferred.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow creative references.

- Reliable communication and turnaround times.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Put ROCK PENGUIN MEDIA - PHOTOSHOP EDITOR in the subject line 

2. A portfolio with examples of advanced Photoshop editing.

3. Before-and-after examples of photo manipulation.

4. Examples of fantasy, cinematic, double-exposure, or motion blur edits.

5. Your typical turnaround time for 5–10 images.

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the project budgets listed above.



**Applicants without examples of advanced Photoshop manipulation will not be considered.**



We are looking for a talented, creative editor interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with Rock Penguin Media.



Payments will be made via Wise.

title: Senior Accountant / Accounting Manager – U.S. Company
description:
Senior Accountant / Accounting Manager – U.S. Company



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



About the Company



Manorly is a growing, Dallas, Texas-based home management, maintenance, and remodeling company providing high-quality services to residential clients.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized Senior Accountant or Accounting Manager based in the Philippines to take ownership of our accounting operations, month-end closing process, financial reporting, and financial controls.



This is not an entry-level bookkeeping or data-entry position. We are looking for an experienced accounting professional who can independently manage the books, produce accurate financial statements, identify discrepancies, and provide meaningful financial insight to company leadership.



Key Responsibilities



Month-End Closing & Financial Reporting



* Independently manage the full monthly accounting close process.

* Prepare and review monthly Profit & Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow Statements.

* Reconcile all bank accounts, credit cards, loans, and balance sheet accounts.

* Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and other month-end adjustments.

* Maintain accurate general ledger records in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

* Prepare monthly budget-versus-actual reports and investigate material variances.

* Prepare monthly financial reporting packages for leadership.

* Coordinate year-end closing and provide supporting documentation to external CPAs and tax professionals.



Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



* Oversee AP and AR accounting processes and ensure accurate recording of transactions.

* Review vendor bills, payment records, and outstanding liabilities.

* Reconcile vendor balances and ensure payments are properly recorded.

* Review AR aging reports and identify outstanding balances, unapplied payments, and discrepancies.

* Ensure customer invoices, deposits, credits, and payments are accurately reflected in QuickBooks.

* Maintain AP and AR reporting and provide recommendations to management.



Cash Flow & Financial Management



* Prepare and maintain short-term cash flow forecasts.

* Monitor cash balances, upcoming obligations, and expected receivables.

* Prepare weekly cash position and financial summaries.

* Identify cash flow concerns and recommend improvements.

* Support leadership with budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.



Project & Job Cost Accounting



* Track revenue, costs, and profitability by project, job, or service division.

* Ensure subcontractor expenses, materials, and labor are correctly allocated.

* Reconcile project-related expenses and billing.

* Assist with analyzing profitability across service and remodeling operations.



Systems & Process Improvement



* Maintain accurate accounting records within QuickBooks Online.

* Work with Ramp or similar expense management and AP automation platforms.

* Ensure transactions sync correctly between financial systems.

* Identify opportunities to automate accounting workflows and improve efficiency.

* Develop and maintain accounting procedures, month-end close checklists, and financial controls.



Required Qualifications



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field.

* Minimum 5 years of professional accounting experience, including substantial experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

* Expert-level proficiency with QuickBooks Online.

* Demonstrated experience independently completing the full month-end closing process.

* Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, and general ledger management.

* Experience preparing complete financial statements, including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statements.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and financial reporting.

* Strong experience with bank reconciliations, journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, AP, and AR.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and communicate directly with U.S. leadership.

* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to identify and resolve accounting discrepancies.



Preferred Qualifications



* Philippine CPA license or equivalent accounting certification.

* QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.

* Hands-on experience with Ramp, including Bill Pay, expense management, and QuickBooks integration.

* Experience with Buildertrend, construction accounting, remodeling, or home services.

* Experience with job costing, work in progress (WIP), and project profitability.

* Experience with multiple entities or business divisions.

* Experience building financial dashboards, cash flow forecasts, and management reports.

* Previous experience as a Senior Accountant, Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller, or Controller.



What We’re Looking For



We need someone who takes ownership of the accounting function, rather than simply completing assigned tasks.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, technically strong, and comfortable communicating directly with company leadership.



You should be able to review financial statements, recognize when something does not make sense, investigate discrepancies, and recommend solutions without requiring constant supervision.



Position Details



* Location: Philippines (100% Remote)

* Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

* Working hours: Must provide consistent overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours

* Compensation: Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

* Employment: Long-term opportunity



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you worked in accounting for U.S.-based businesses?

2. How many years of hands-on QuickBooks Online experience do you have?

3. Have you independently managed the full month-end close and prepared financial statements? Explain your responsibilities.

4. Have you used Ramp for AP, expense management, or accounting integrations? If not, what similar systems have you used?

5. Have you worked in construction, remodeling, or a service-based business with job costing?

6. Describe a significant accounting error or discrepancy you discovered and how you resolved it.

7. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

8. What hours are you available to work that overlap with U.S. Central Time?



Qualified candidates may be asked to complete a paid accounting skills assessment as part of the interview process.

title: Experienced Cold Caller / Sales Specialist | $800 Base + Bonuses
description:
EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-Time

SALARY: $800 USD/month base + performance bonuses

HOURS: 45 hours per week

SCHEDULE: Within 7:30 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Central Time



*FAILURE TO FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS WILL RESULT IN YOUR APPLICATION NOT BEING REVIEWED 



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will call homeowners to find out whether they are interested in selling their off-market properties. Your job is to start natural conversations, identify motivated sellers, gather property information, and pass qualified opportunities to our acquisitions team.



This requires more than asking, “Do you want to sell?” You must uncover the homeowner’s motivation, property condition, selling timeline, and price expectations while building trust.



REQUIREMENTS



• At least two years of cold-calling or outbound sales experience, including experience calling homeowners for a real estate investor or wholesaling business.

• Fluent English with clear pronunciation and confident, natural delivery.

• Experience qualifying motivated sellers and handling homeowner objections.

• Demonstrated success meeting calling and qualified-lead targets.

• Ability to follow a script while adapting naturally to the conversation.

• Experience using a dialer and CRM.

• Reliable internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.

• Availability for the schedule listed above.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make outbound calls to homeowners about potentially selling their properties.

• Identify interested sellers and understand their reasons for selling.

• Gather details about property condition, needed repairs, occupancy, timeline, and asking price.

• Distinguish genuine selling opportunities from general interest.

• Document accurate notes and arrange follow-up calls with our acquisitions team.

• Follow up with homeowners who may be interested in selling later.

• Meet established daily KPIs and apply coaching.

• Follow calling procedures and accurately record requests for no further contact.



REQUIRED SALES AUDITION



Submit a 3–5-minute voice recording or video covering the following. Voice recordings are required at minimum; video submissions receive bonus consideration.



YOUR REAL ESTATE EXPERIENCE



Explain your experience calling homeowners. What markets did you call? Which dialers and CRMs did you use? What were your daily targets and actual results? Explain what counted as a qualified seller lead.



MOCK HOMEOWNER CALL



Use this fictional scenario:



You are calling the owner of an off-market property on Oak Street on behalf of a real estate investor. The homeowner says:



“I might sell, but only if the price is right.”



Demonstrate your introduction, ask questions to qualify the seller, and explain how you would secure a follow-up conversation with our acquisitions team. Show how you would uncover motivation, condition, timeline, and price expectations.



You may state hypothetical homeowner answers to keep the demonstration moving. Do not invent a purchase offer or promise a closing date.



OBJECTION HANDLING



Demonstrate how you would respond to:



• “How did you get my number?”

• “I’m not interested in selling right now.”

• “What are you offering?”



We are evaluating clear English, relevant questions, respectful objection handling, and your ability to identify a genuine selling opportunity. Keep your delivery conversational.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line: “Real Estate Sales Audition – [Your Full Name]”



Include:



• An accessible link to your voice recording or video.

• Your résumé or a brief summary of your real estate calling experience.

• Your previous calling targets and actual qualified-lead results.

• Confirmation that you accept $800 USD/month base plus performance bonuses and can work 45 hours per week within the stated schedule.

• Your earliest start date.



Applications without an accessible recording will not be considered. Sales ability and communication quality will carry the most weight.



Only the strongest submissions will be invited to a short live interview and mock homeowner call.



Best,

title: Land Underwriter & Dispositions Manager — Civil Engineer / Appraiser / BPO Experience — US Land Company — Long-term
description:
Land Underwriter & Dispositions Manager. Remote, full-time, 9am–5pm US Eastern. Long-term role with a veteran-owned US land company.



About Patriot Plots. Patriot Plots is a veteran-owned land investment company based in Pennsylvania. We buy rural land directly from owners and resell it, and we subdivide larger parcels into building lots. We have closed 57 deals since 2023 across 15+ states (Georgia, the Carolinas, Tennessee, Alabama, Virginia, New Hampshire, Vermont, Maine, New York and more). We are a small, remote, process-driven team with our own operations platform, and we are hiring the person who will own valuation and the deal-to-cash side of the business.



The role. You will value land and run every deal from signed contract to money in the bank. That means pulling sold comps and adjusting for frontage, utilities, topography and wetlands; setting our maximum offer and our asking price; screening subdivide candidates; and then driving due diligence, closing, listing and resale. You will be on the phone every day with US title companies, surveyors, perc and soil testers, septic designers, utility companies, county planning offices and real estate agents. Within 90 days you run this with the owner reviewing only large or unusual deals.



What you will do. Underwrite 15–30 parcels a week: sold comps, adjustments, a value, a maximum offer, and a one-paragraph reasoning the closer can use on the phone. Screen subdivide candidates against our checklist (zoning, minimum lot size, frontage, legal access, water and sewer, lot yield) and build a simple pro forma. Run due diligence and closing on every purchase: title, survey, perc test, utility availability, deed restrictions, HOA; keep every file moving every day. Price and list every property we own; coordinate agents, photos, drone, signs and listing sites; follow up with buyers; get buyer contracts to close. Build and manage our vendor bench by state: title companies, surveyors, perc testers, clearing contractors, septic designers, electricians. Own the weekly inventory report: every lot, days held, carrying cost, next action, and who it is waiting on. Log every valuation against the actual sale price so your accuracy is measured and improves.



Must have. Credentials: a degree in civil engineering, geodetic engineering or surveying, architecture, urban or land-use planning, real estate appraisal, environmental science, geology, or agriculture and land management; or 3+ years working in land development, appraisal or BPO work, title or conveyancing, a surveying office, or municipal planning. You already know the basics: perc test, plat, easement, road frontage, setback, septic permit, floodplain, minor vs. major subdivision. We will not teach these; if we explain something once, you have it. Clear, neutral spoken English: this is a phone job with US contractors and agents, a voice sample is required, and a heavy accent is a disqualifier with no exceptions. Comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; you can show your math. Available 9:00am–5:00pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday, with fast internet and a backup for power and internet. Self-managed: you bring the decision and the reasoning, not the question.



Nice to have. BPO or appraisal support for US lenders or REO companies; US county GIS and assessor records. Subdivision or site-development experience. CRM experience (GoHighLevel or similar), Google Workspace, land data tools (Land Portal, LandID, Regrid).



Compensation and terms. Competitive pay for a credentialed professional, set by your credentials and your test results. Paid twice a month, plus a quarterly bonus tied to gross profit on resales, and paid time off after 90 days. Independent contractor. We discuss the specific figure with finalists; tell us your monthly expectation in your application. This is a long-term role; we want the person who runs this for years. Location: fully remote. Philippines, South Africa, Colombia, Mexico, Argentina, Brazil and elsewhere welcome, as long as you work Eastern hours.



Hiring process. 1) Written application on OnlineJobs.ph (below), reviewed within 2 business days. 2) Shortlisted candidates get a paid ($100) 72-hour underwriting test on six of our real closed deals. 3) Two interviews: one with the owner, one live working session on a current file. 4) Offer. Target start date: December 1, 2026.



How to apply (read carefully; applications that skip a step are not reviewed). Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line exactly: LAND UNDERWRITER — Your Name — Your Country. In your application message, numbered 1 to 9: 1) City, country, and your confirmation that you can work 9am–5pm US Eastern. 2) Degree(s), field, school and year. 3) Relevant work experience in 3–6 lines (land, appraisal, title, survey, planning, engineering). 4) Voice sample: record yourself on Vocaroo reading the script below and paste the link. 5) Include your resume (or a link to your resume PDF) and your LinkedIn URL if you have one. 6) Answer the five questions below in your own words; keep each answer under 120 words; show your math where asked. 7) Monthly pay expectation in USD and your earliest start date. 8) Your internet speed (Speedtest) and your backup if power or internet goes out. 9) Where you saw this post.



Voice script (read it naturally, about 45 seconds): "Hi, this is [your name] calling from Patriot Plots about the perc test on the Beaver Trail parcel in Abbeville County. We need the soil evaluation scheduled before the fifteenth, and I want to confirm the surveyor has the recorded easement on the plat. Can you also check whether the septic permit requires a conventional or an alternative system? The nearest power pole is about twelve hundred feet from the build site, so we are getting a quote from the utility this week. Thanks, I will follow up in writing with the parcel number."



The five questions. 1) In three sentences: what is a perc test, who performs it, and what result would stop you from buying a lot meant for a home? 2) A 10-acre parcel touches a paved county road for 40 feet; the rest of the boundary is other people's land. The county's minimum lot width is 100 feet. What is the problem, and what would you check next? 3) The nearest power pole is 1,200 feet from the build site. How does that change what you would pay for the parcel, and what is the first call you make? 4) You are valuing a 5-acre parcel. Three sold comps from the last six months, all with similar road access and utilities: 4.2 acres sold for $38,000; 6.1 acres sold for $52,000; 5.5 acres sold for $41,000. What is your market value for the 5 acres, and what would you offer if the company needs to buy at 55% of value? Show the math. 5) In one paragraph: what is the difference between a minor and a major subdivision in a typical US county, and what are two things that usually push a split into "major"?



Patriot Plots is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on credentials, test results and communication, nothing else.

description:
Customer Support Agent – Health & Beauty E-commerce (Remote, Full-Time)



We’re a growing e-commerce company in the health and beauty space — supplements, creams, oils, and more — selling across 10 different countries via Meta. We’re looking for a reliable and empathetic customer support agent to handle client inquiries via
 and manage comments across our
 pages.



This is a long-term, full-time role. We value loyalty, trust, and people who take ownership of their work.



What You’ll Do



You’ll be the frontline of our brand — the person our customers interact with when they have questions, concerns, or issues. Your main responsibilities will include:



Responding to customer
s accurately and in a timely manner (order inquiries, shipping questions, product information, complaints, refund requests, etc.)

Monitoring and clearing comments on our
 ad pages — answering questions, addressing concerns, and removing spam or negative comments according to our guidelines

Following our response templates and tone of voice while adapting replies to each customer’s specific situation

Long-term position with room to grow alongside the team

Experience in customer support, ideally for an e-commerce or DTC brand but not mandatory

Comfortable managing high volumes of
s and social media comments without sacrificing quality

Familiar with
 Business pages and comment moderation

Availability — What does your life outside of work look like? We need to understand any recurring commitments (family obligations, church, studies, etc.). Please be honest — we take trust seriously and are building for the long term.



Looking forward to meeting you.



— William

title: 🚨 EXPERIENCE REQUIRED | VIDEO APPLICATION REQUIRED  We are looking for an experienced Operations & SOP Manager to help

We need someone who can take our existing processes, organize them into clear systems, create SOPs, assign responsibilities, and make sure our team operates efficiently.



**We are NOT looking for someone who needs to be taught how to create SOPs or manage workflows.**

✅ Work with the CEO to turn ideas into organized, repeatable systems.

Requirements



- Previous experience in operations management, SOP development, or project management.

- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

- Experience using project management software.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, or similar business tools.

- Excellent English communication skills.

- Ability to create SOPs independently using written instructions, screenshots, and Loom videos.

- Experience managing remote teams and tracking accountability.

- Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work without constant supervision.



**Experience with GoHighLevel, credit repair, real estate, or online education businesses is a major bonus.**



## What Success Looks Like



We want every department to have clear systems so that:



✅ Every employee knows exactly what to do.



✅ Every task has an owner and deadline.



✅ Every process has a documented SOP.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, builds systems, and gets things done.



**Good Credit Now 101 | Operations Team**

title: Experienced Airbnb Operations VA (Full-Time)
description:
OVERVIEW:

Cartiall Homes manages short-term rental and serviced accommodation properties across London. We are searching for an experienced Short-Term Rental Operations VA (full-time) with 2+ years of Airbnb or short-term rental management experience to run the day-to-day of our portfolio: guest services, turnovers, admin and landlord queries.



You will own one outcome: every guest gets a fast, accurate reply and every stay runs smoothly. Once a property is live, you keep it running. You will also create and publish new listings when we take on a property. We trust you to run this without being micromanaged.





TASKS:

Guest Services

● Replying to guest messages across Airbnb, 
 and other platforms

● Chasing guest reviews

● Handling guest complaints professionally

● Sending upsell offers (early check-in, late check-out, etc.)

● Handling direct bookings

● Managing damage and other claims through the platforms



Turnovers

● Coordinating cleaning and laundry for every stay, and confirming each clean is done before the guest arrives

● Making sure consumables are stocked

● Logging maintenance issues and following them up until resolved



Admin

● Optimising listings (titles, descriptions, photos)

● Keeping the expense log up to date

● Updating the metrics dashboard

● Updating the task list



Landlords

● Responding to day-to-day landlord queries and escalating anything bigger



Onboarding New Properties

● Creating and publishing new listings from scratch



Note: this is the core of the role, not the limit of it. Additional tasks will be added as we grow.





OUR STANDARDS:

● Guests get a reply within 15 minutes

● Every clean is confirmed before the guest arrives

● Every issue is logged, even if it is fixed

● Anything you cannot solve is escalated the same day, not left in the inbox





REQUIREMENTS:

● Minimum 2 years of experience in Airbnb or short-term rental management (required)

● References from a previous employer (required)

● Hands-on experience creating and optimising Airbnb listings

● Experience handling guest messaging, reviews, complaints and damage claims

● Speak & write in fluent English (Native English Level)

● Comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards and task trackers

● Organised, proactive and calm under pressure

● Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

● Available full-time, Monday to Saturday





PROVIDED:

● A written SOP and short screen recording for every task

● Recurring daily tasks, so you know exactly what to do when you log on

● Honest feedback, real ownership of the role, and room to grow as we add more properties

● Pay on time, every time





HOURS: Full-time, 45 hours/week, Monday to Saturday UK time





RATE: $900 per month 





HOW TO RESPOND:

1. Reply to this job posting with your CV and the contact details of at least one previous employer who can act as a reference.



2. Start your response with the word “Guest-first”. Why? This lets us see who is actually paying attention.



3. Answer these questions in your response:

● How many properties have you managed, and on which platforms?

● A guest messages at 9pm saying they cannot get into the property. What do you do?

● A guest checks out and the cleaner reports damage. Walk us through your next steps.

● Which shift are you applying for, and when could you start?



Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.

title: B2B SaaS Growth & Market Research Specialist
description:
B2B SaaS Growth, Market Research & Sales Specialist



Job Type: Remote | Part-Time Initially | Potential Long-Term Role



About the Company



We are establishing an AI-powered B2B SaaS company focused on developing scalable software solutions that solve real business problems.



We are seeking an entrepreneurial, independent, and commercially minded individual who can take ownership of the entire business growth process, from identifying profitable software opportunities to acquiring and retaining paying customers.



This is not a traditional marketing position. You will be responsible for helping identify what we should build, validating demand, and eventually bringing the product to market.



You will work directly with the founder and have significant autonomy in executing your responsibilities.



Key Responsibilities



1. SaaS Opportunity Research

- Independently research and identify profitable B2B SaaS opportunities.

- Discover repetitive, costly business problems that could be solved through AI and automation.

- Analyze existing competitors, pricing models, and underserved markets.

- Evaluate potential opportunities based on commercial viability, scalability, and customer demand.

- Prepare concise, evidence-based recommendations for the founder.



2. Customer Discovery & Market Validation

- Identify relevant businesses and decision-makers.

- Conduct customer discovery interviews independently.

- Validate business problems and willingness to pay.

- Test potential pricing and subscription models.

- Identify prospective pilot customers.

- Present findings and recommendations based on actual market feedback.



3. Sales & Customer Acquisition

- Develop and execute B2B lead generation strategies.

- Manage cold
 and LinkedIn outreach.

- Schedule and conduct product demonstrations.

- Manage the sales pipeline and follow-ups.

- Convert qualified prospects into paying subscribers.

- Develop scalable customer acquisition processes.



4. Marketing & Growth

- Develop and implement digital marketing strategies.

- Coordinate landing pages, content,
 campaigns, and SEO.

- Analyze customer acquisition costs and conversion rates.

- Identify opportunities to increase revenue and customer retention.

- Conduct competitor monitoring and ongoing market research.



5. Customer Success & Operations

- Manage initial customer onboarding.

- Handle routine customer enquiries.

- Gather product feedback and feature requests.

- Coordinate with the developer to resolve customer issues.

- Maintain customer records and sales reporting.

- Create repeatable processes for future growth.



What We're Looking For



- Experience in B2B SaaS, startup growth, sales, or market research.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong research, analytical, and commercial judgment.

- Experience with B2B lead generation and outbound prospecting.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable speaking directly with business owners and decision-makers.

- Familiarity with AI tools and modern SaaS business models.

description:
